gog-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
gog-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

golan.title: Golan
golan.note: One of the three cities of refuge east of the Jordan, in Bashan, where someone who had killed by accident could run from revenge. It went to the Gershonite Levites and later gave its name to the region, which is why there are Golan Heights today. The exact site is not known.

gomer.title: Gomer
gomer.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
gomer.note: Genesis 10 makes him a son of Japheth, and the name stands for his descendants too, which is how Ezekiel 38:6 can list Gomer as a nation. Hosea's wife has the same name and is a different person.

gozan.title: Gozan
gozan.note: When Assyria took the northern kingdom, it resettled Israelite captives in this region of northern Mesopotamia.

guni-2.title: Guni
guni-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
guni-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

guni.title: Guni
guni.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
guni.note: One of Naphtali's sons, and a clan of the tribe came from him.

habor.title: Habor
habor.note: After Samaria fell in 722 BC, the Assyrians deported the northern kingdom's people to this river and its district. It is the Khabur, a big tributary of the Euphrates in what is now northeastern Syria.

hadad-3.title: Hadad
hadad-3.about: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
hadad-3.note: A son of Ishmael, in the list of Genesis 25:15. Nothing else is told of him.

hadad-2.title: Hadad
hadad-2.about: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
hadad-2.note: One of the kings of Edom, in Genesis 36 and the matching list in Chronicles. The name was common among them.

hadad-4.title: Hadad
hadad-4.about: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
hadad-4.note: One of 3 men called Hadad. This one is a king from the patriarchs, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

hadoram.title: Hadoram
hadoram.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
hadoram.note: Genesis 10:27 makes him one of Joktan's sons. Under the same name Chronicles has a prince sent to congratulate David on a victory, and the official over Solomon's forced labour who was stoned to death when the kingdom split under Rehoboam.

hagarene.title: Hagarene
hagarene.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hagarene.note: They were nomads east of Gilead, beaten by Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh in a war Chronicles records.

haggiah.title: Haggiah
haggiah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
haggiah.note: A Merarite Levite, in the line of Levi's descendants who served in the temple.

haggith.title: Haggith
haggith.about: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
haggith.note: She was one of David's wives and Adonijah's mother, and her son tried to take the throne while David was dying.

halah.title: Halah
halah.note: A district in Assyria, probably near Nineveh, where Israelites were deported after Samaria fell. Sargon II boasts in his own inscriptions of taking tens of thousands from Samaria around 722 BC.

ham.title: Ham
ham.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
ham.note: Noah's son. He saw his father drunk and naked in the tent and told his brothers instead of covering him, and when Noah woke he cursed Ham's son Canaan, not Ham. Egypt and Cush are among the peoples Genesis 10 traces to him.

hamathite.title: Hamathite
hamathite.note: The people of Hamath, counted among Canaan's descendants. Their city on the Orontes kept marking Israel's northern border, and Assyrian records put its king Irhuleni beside Ahab against Shalmaneser III at Qarqar in 853 BC.

hammath.title: Hammath
hammath.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hammath.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

hammoleketh.title: Hammoleketh
hammoleketh.note: Gilead's sister, from Manasseh, and the mother of Abiezer, Ishod and Mahalah. Her name means the queen, and nothing else is recorded about her.

hammon.title: Hammon
hammon.note: Two towns. One was in Asher near Sidon, probably Umm el-Amoud, and the other a Levitical city in Naphtali, likely Hammath by the Sea of Galilee.

hamuel.title: Hamuel
hamuel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hamuel.note: Simeonite, among Shaul's descendants in 1 Chronicles 4:26. No other information about him survives.

hamul.title: Hamul
hamul.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hamul.note: Perez's son and Judah's grandson. One of Judah's clans came from him.

hananiah-4.title: Hananiah
hananiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hananiah-4.note: One of 15 men called Hananiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

hananiah-5.title: Hananiah
hananiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hananiah-5.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

hanniel.title: Hanniel
hanniel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hanniel.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

hara.title: Hara
hara.note: Members of Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh were deported here by the Assyrians. It seems to have lain along the Khabur River, and Tiglath-pileser III's own annals record the deportation.

haran-3.title: Haran
haran-3.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
haran-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

hareph.title: Hareph
hareph.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hareph.note: A son of Hur in Judah's genealogy, and founder of Beth-gader; the chapter uses his name to mark a town's clan.

harnepher.title: Harnepher
harnepher.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
harnepher.note: Zophah's son, a chief of Asher, in 1 Chronicles 7:36. Nothing beyond the name survives.

harum.title: Harum
harum.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
harum.note: Aharhel's father, in Judah's genealogy at 1 Chronicles 4:8.

hasadiah.title: Hasadiah
hasadiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hasadiah.note: In David's royal line after the exile, one of Pedaiah's sons. Nothing else about him is recorded.

hasenuah-including-the-art.title: Hasenuah
hasenuah-including-the-art.note: The Hebrew name carries the article, the Senuah. A Benjamite family that settled in Jerusalem after the exile traced itself back to him.

hashabiah-6.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah-6.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hashabiah-6.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

hashabiah-3.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah-3.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
hashabiah-3.note: 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

hashub.title: Hashub
hashub.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
hashub.note: The Levite of this name in the lists of those living in Jerusalem after the return.

hashubah.title: Hashubah
hashubah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hashubah.note: David's line, after the exile: one of the sons listed after Zerubbabel in the royal genealogy.

hattush-2.title: Hattush
hattush-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hattush-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

havilah.title: Havilah
havilah.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
havilah.note: Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the patriarchs.

havilah-2.title: Havilah
havilah-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
havilah-2.note: Cush's son in Genesis 10:7. The same name is also a land rich in gold by Eden's rivers, and a son of Joktan, so it may cover more than one region.

hazar-shual.title: Hazar-shual
hazar-shual.note: Village of the jackal. It sat on Judah's southern border and later fell inside Simeon's share, and people came back to live there after the exile. It is commonly placed near Tell es-Sa'weh, between Beersheba and Moladah.

hazar-susim.title: Hazar-susim
hazar-susim.note: The same town Joshua calls Hazar-susah. In the Simeonite clan lists of 1 Chronicles 4:31 the name is plural, village of horses.

hazarmaveth.title: Hazarmaveth
hazarmaveth.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
hazarmaveth.note: Joktan's son, in the Arabian branch of Shem's descendants. The name survives almost unchanged in Hadramawt, a region of southern Arabia in Yemen known in the ancient world for frankincense and spice.

hazelelponi.title: Hazelelponi
hazelelponi.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hazelelponi.note: A woman in Judah's genealogy, sister of the sons of Etam. Nothing further is recorded about her.

heber-3.title: Heber
heber-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
heber-3.note: One of 4 men called Heber. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

heber-4.title: Heber
heber-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
heber-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

heber.title: Heber
heber.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
heber.note: Not the Kenite. This Heber is in Genesis 46:17 among the family that went down to Egypt, and Numbers 26:45 makes him the head of a clan.

hebron.title: Hebron
hebron.note: Abraham camped near here at Mamre and bought the cave of Machpelah to bury Sarah. It sits in the hill country south of Jerusalem, once called Kirjath-arba, and Joshua gave it to Caleb. David reigned there seven years before moving to Jerusalem, and Herod's great stone enclosure over the traditional tomb still stands.

hebron-2.title: Hebron
hebron-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hebron-2.note: Kohath's son, a Levite, and a clan of Levites came from him.

hebron-3.title: Hebron
hebron-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hebron-3.note: One of 3 men called Hebron. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

helah.title: Helah
helah.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
helah.note: One of the two wives of Ashur, founder of Tekoa, in Judah's genealogy.

helem-2.title: Helem
helem-2.note: Of Asher, through Beriah's line, in the tribal genealogy at 1 Chronicles 7:35.

helez-2.title: Helez
helez-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
helez-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

heman-3.title: Heman
heman-3.note: One of 3 men called Heman. This one is a man from the years before the monarchy, named once in 1 Chronicles.

heman.title: Heman
heman.about: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
heman.note: David put him among the chief musicians over the worship, a Levite. Psalm 88, one of the darkest laments in the book, is credited to him.

hepher-4.title: Hepher
hepher-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hepher-4.note: One of 4 men called Hepher. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

heresh.title: Heresh
heresh.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
heresh.note: One of the Levites who resettled Jerusalem after the exile, from the gatekeepers who came out of the singers' guild.

hermon.title: Hermon
hermon.note: On Israel's northern border, and the snowmelt off it gives the Psalms their picture of dew. It is near Caesarea Philippi, which makes it a likely site for Jesus's transfiguration.

heshbon.title: Heshbon
heshbon.note: Sihon's capital, east of the Jordan near the northern edge of Moab. Moses took it before Israel crossed into Canaan, and it became a Levitical city in Reuben. Moab later had it back, which is why the prophets name it in their judgments on Moab, and the ruins, still called Hesban, lie about twenty miles east of the Jordan.

heth.title: Heth
heth.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
heth.note: Canaan's son and the father of the Hittites, the people Abraham bought Sarah's burial cave from and the people Uriah, Bathsheba's husband, came from generations later.

hezeki.title: Hezeki
hezeki.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hezeki.note: A Benjamite descended from Elpaal, in the Chronicles genealogy, and that is the whole entry.

hezekiah.title: Hezekiah
hezekiah.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hezekiah.note: One of Judah's few good kings. He came after Ahaz, reopened the temple, tore down the high places, and broke up the bronze serpent Moses had made once people began worshipping it. When Sennacherib besieged Jerusalem in 701 BC, Hezekiah prayed, Isaiah promised deliverance, and the siege broke overnight. His seal impression has been dug up near the Temple Mount, and his tunnel still runs under the city.

hezron.title: Hezron
hezron.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hezron.note: Perez's son, and the line that ends in David runs through him; Ruth closes with it and Matthew picks it up. The same name marks a spot on Judah's southern border, west of Kadesh-barnea.

hezron-2.title: Hezron
hezron-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hezron-2.note: Reuben's son, listed with the family that went down to Egypt and again in Reuben's line in Exodus and Chronicles. He is a different man from Perez's son of the same name.

hilen.title: Hilen
hilen.note: Joshua's list calls it Holon. It was a town of Judah handed over, with its pasturelands, to Aaron's descendants among the Levites, and nobody knows where it stood.

hillkiah.title: Hillkiah
hillkiah.about: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hillkiah.note: The high priest under Josiah who found a forgotten scroll of the law while the temple was being repaired. What he found set off Judah's last great reform.

hillkiah-5.title: Hillkiah
hillkiah-5.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hillkiah-5.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

hivite.title: Hivite
hivite.note: One of the peoples in the land before Israel. At Shechem a Hivite's son raped Dinah, and at Gibeon Hivites tricked Joshua into a treaty by pretending to come from far off, which put the city under Israel's protection.

hod.title: Hod
hod.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hod.note: Son of Zophah, of Asher, and one verse is all there is.

hodaiah.title: Hodaiah
hodaiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hodaiah.note: After the exile the royal line of Judah keeps going in a list, and Hodaiah is in it, a son of Elioenai. Nothing further is recorded about him.

hodaviah.title: Hodaviah
hodaviah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hodaviah.note: A chief of the half-tribe of Manasseh, east of the Jordan. The name means "praise the LORD", and no story goes with it.

hodaviah-2.title: Hodaviah
hodaviah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hodaviah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

hodesh.title: Hodesh
hodesh.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hodesh.note: Shaharaim sent away two wives, Hushim and Baara, and had sons in Moab by others. Hodesh was one of them, and she is named so her sons, heads of Benjamite families, could be recorded.

hodijah.title: Hodijah
hodijah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hodijah.note: The name turns up among those who helped the people understand the law after Ezra read it out, and again among the signers of the covenant under Nehemiah; it was a common Levitical name.

homam.title: Homam
homam.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
homam.note: The name is Edomite, from the line of Seir the Horite, and Genesis spells it Hemam.

hori.title: Hori
hori.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
hori.note: In Edom's genealogies he is one of the Horite clan chiefs, and that is all the record gives.

hormah.title: Hormah
hormah.note: Its name means "devoted to destruction", and it was first called Zephath. Israel was beaten there after going into Canaan without the Lord, following the spies' report. Later Israel vowed to destroy the cities of the region, and the vow, kept under Joshua, gave the town its name.

hoshama.title: Hoshama
hoshama.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hoshama.note: Son of Jeconiah, the king of Judah taken to Babylon, and probably born while his father was a prisoner there. Nothing further is recorded about him.

hotham-2.title: Hotham
hotham-2.note: Heber's son, of Beriah's clan and a chief in Asher; another Hotham turns up among David's warriors.

hukkok.title: Hukkok
hukkok.note: A Levitical town near the border of Naphtali and Asher, not far from the Jordan. It may be the village of Yakuk near the Sea of Galilee.

hul.title: Hul
hul.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
hul.note: Aram's son, Shem's grandson, in the Table of Nations. Like the other names there it probably means a clan or district. Its location is not known.

huppim.title: Huppim
huppim.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
huppim.note: Another of Benjamin's sons, whose descendants became one of the tribe's clans in the genealogies.

hur.title: Hur
hur.about: Aaron's compatriot living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
hur.note: He helped Aaron hold up Moses's arms while Israel fought Amalek, since Israel won as long as those hands stayed up. When Moses went up Sinai for the law, Hur was left in charge with Aaron.

huram-3.title: Huram
huram-3.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
huram-3.note: One of 3 men called Huram. This one is a man from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

huri.title: Huri
huri.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
huri.note: A Gadite in Bashan, east of the Jordan, and father of Abihail. Gad's genealogy runs through him down to family heads in the days of Jotham of Judah and Jeroboam II of Israel. Nothing else is recorded about him.

hushah.title: Hushah
hushah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hushah.note: One name in Judah's genealogy, tied to the descendants of Ezer.

husham.title: Husham
husham.about: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
husham.note: He was king of Edom in the days before Israel had any king.

hushim-2.title: Hushim
hushim-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hushim-2.note: One of 3 men called Hushim. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

hushim.title: Hushim
hushim.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hushim.note: One of the wives of a Benjamite clan leader in the Chronicles genealogy. The same name belongs to a son of Dan.

ibhar.title: Ibhar
ibhar.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
ibhar.note: Born to David in Jerusalem, after he was king, and nothing more.

ibneiah.title: Ibneiah
ibneiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ibneiah.note: Jeroham's son, a Benjamite, among the family heads who settled in Jerusalem after the exile.

ibnijah.title: Ibnijah
ibnijah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ibnijah.note: After the exile he was one of the Benjamite family heads living in Jerusalem, and that is the extent of him.

idbash.title: Idbash
idbash.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
idbash.note: One of three sons of "the father of Etam", in Judah's genealogy, with a sister named Hazelelponi.

iddo-5.title: Iddo
iddo-5.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
iddo-5.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

igal.title: Igal
igal.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
igal.note: One of 3 men called Igal. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

immer-2.title: Immer
immer-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
immer-2.note: 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

imna-2.title: Imna
imna-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
imna-2.note: A later man of Asher's line, in Chronicles, distinct from Asher's own son of the same name.

imna.title: Imna
imna.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
imna.note: A son of Asher. Genesis, Numbers and Chronicles all list him. Numbers counts a clan from him.

imrah.title: Imrah
imrah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
imrah.note: Zophah's son, in Asher's family lines in Chronicles.

imri.title: Imri
imri.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
imri.note: His family, from Judah, was among those who resettled Jerusalem after the exile. Chronicles gives his name as an ancestor and nothing about him.

iphedeiah.title: Iphedeiah
iphedeiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
iphedeiah.note: One of Benjamin's chiefs, in the Chronicles genealogy of families settled in Jerusalem.

ir.title: Ir
ir.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
ir.note: A hard verse in Benjamin's genealogy, and many read this name as a variant of Iri, Bela's son a few verses earlier. Nothing else is known.

iram.title: Iram
iram.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
iram.note: A clan chief of Edom, from Esau's descendants in the hill country of Seir.

iri.title: Iri
iri.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
iri.note: Bela's son and Benjamin's grandson, head of a family in Benjamin's genealogy.

irnahash.title: Irnahash
irnahash.note: "City of the serpent", one of the town names in Judah's genealogy. Nobody knows where it was.

iru.title: Iru
iru.note: Caleb's eldest son. Caleb was the faithful spy who got Hebron. Nothing further is recorded about Iru.

isaac.title: Isaac
isaac.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
isaac.note: Abraham and Sarah's promised son, born when his father was a hundred. God told Abraham to sacrifice him on Mount Moriah and provided a ram at the last moment. Old and blind, he was tricked by Jacob into giving him Esau's blessing, and he never left Canaan or took a second wife.

isaiah.title: Isaiah
isaiah.about: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
isaiah.note: Amoz's son, a prophet in Jerusalem in the eighth century, who counselled four kings of Judah and is quoted in the New Testament more than any other prophet. He gave his two sons names that were sermons, Shear-jashub and Maher-shalal-hash-baz. When Sennacherib besieged Jerusalem he told Hezekiah the city would stand, and the Taylor Prism brags of the siege without ever claiming the city fell.

ishbah.title: Ishbah
ishbah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishbah.note: "Father of Eshtemoa" in Judah's genealogy, which probably means he founded the town's settlement rather than fathered a son. Nothing else is recorded about him.

ishbak.title: Ishbak
ishbak.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
ishbak.note: Abraham had him by Keturah. He is usually taken as the ancestor of an Arabian tribe, but nobody can say which.

ishi.title: Ishi
ishi.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishi.note: Named once in Judah's genealogy. The word means "my husband", and Hosea uses it for Israel coming back to God, in place of the colder "my master".

ishi-2.title: Ishi
ishi-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishi-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

ishi-3.title: Ishi
ishi-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishi-3.note: One of 4 men called Ishi. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ishi-4.title: Ishi
ishi-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishi-4.note: A name in the genealogies of Judah and Manasseh. The word itself means my husband, and Hosea uses it for what Israel will call God again.

ishiah-4.title: Ishiah
ishiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishiah-4.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

ishma.title: Ishma
ishma.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ishma.note: One name in a short, tangled fragment of Judah's genealogy, grouped with Etam.

ishmael-2.title: Ishmael
ishmael-2.about: Abraham's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
ishmael-2.note: Abraham's first son, by Hagar, Sarah's servant. Sarah had given Hagar to Abraham while she was still childless, then wanted mother and son gone after Isaac came. God promised Hagar her son would father a great nation too, though the covenant line ran through Isaac.

ishmael-3.title: Ishmael
ishmael-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishmael-3.note: One of 6 men called Ishmael. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

ishmaelite.title: Ishmaelite
ishmaelite.about: Abraham's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
ishmaelite.note: The Ishmaelites came from Abraham's son Ishmael and traded across the country south and east of Canaan. One of their caravans bought Joseph from his brothers and took him down to Egypt.

ishmerai.title: Ishmerai
ishmerai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishmerai.note: From Elpaal's family, a Benjamite household head in Jerusalem, and nothing more is said of him.

ishod.title: Ishod
ishod.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishod.note: Hammoleketh's son, of the half-tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan.

ishpan.title: Ishpan
ishpan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ishpan.note: A Benjamite listed under Shashak's family, and that is all.

ishuai.title: Ishuai
ishuai.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ishuai.note: One of the household that went down to Egypt, named again in the Numbers census with a clan of his own and once more in Chronicles.

ishvah.title: Ishvah
ishvah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ishvah.note: A son of Asher who went down to Egypt with Jacob's family. Numbers leaves him out of Asher's clans, which may mean he founded no line.

ispah.title: Ispah
ispah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ispah.note: A Benjamite family head from Beriah's line who lived in Jerusalem.

israel.title: Israel
israel.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
israel.note: God gave Jacob this name after he wrestled through the night at Peniel. It became the name of the nation that came from his twelve sons, and later of the northern kingdom and of the land. For the man himself, see Jacob.

issachar.title: Issachar
issachar.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
issachar.note: Jacob's ninth son. His tribe held the fertile Jezreel Valley, and Chronicles says its men understood the times and knew what Israel ought to do.

ithamar.title: Ithamar
ithamar.about: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ithamar.note: Aaron's youngest son. Two of his brothers died for offering unauthorized fire and Eleazar became high priest, and Ithamar was put over the Levites who carried and kept the tabernacle. Eli came from his line, which held the high priesthood for a while before it went back to Eleazar's line under Zadok.

ithran.title: Ithran
ithran.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
ithran.note: A Horite clan name, from Edom's earlier inhabitants.

ithran-2.title: Ithran
ithran-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ithran-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

ithream.title: Ithream
ithream.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
ithream.note: David's sixth son born at Hebron, by his wife Eglah, and the story never mentions him again.

ithrite.title: Ithrite
ithrite.note: Ira and Gareb, two of David's mighty men, both carry this label. It may tie them to Kiriath-jearim, but where the name comes from is not known for sure.

izhar.title: Izhar
izhar.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
izhar.note: He was Kohath's son, and his own son Korah led the rebellion against Moses in the wilderness.

izrahiah.title: Izrahiah
izrahiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
izrahiah.note: Two men. One is a chief of Issachar in the genealogies; the other, generations later, is at the dedication of Jerusalem's rebuilt walls under Nehemiah.

jaakan.title: Jaakan
jaakan.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
jaakan.note: Ezer's son, grandson of Seir the Horite, and Genesis calls him Akan. His descendants gave their name to one of Israel's camps in the wilderness.

jaakobah.title: Jaakobah
jaakobah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jaakobah.note: A clan leader of Simeon, with a name built on the same root as Jacob.

jaanai.title: Jaanai
jaanai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jaanai.note: A Gadite chief in Bashan, named once.

jaazer.title: Jaazer
jaazer.note: Jazer, an Amorite town in Gilead east of the Jordan. Israel took it and gave it to Gad, then to the Levites of Merari. Isaiah and Jeremiah both use its ruined vineyards as a picture of Moab's ruin.

jabez-2.title: Jabez
jabez-2.note: Named once, in 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

jabez.title: Jabez
jabez.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jabez.note: Jabez prayed for God to bless him and widen his borders, and the text says God did. He is from Judah's genealogy, and the prayer is all we have of him.

jachan.title: Jachan
jachan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jachan.note: A Gadite chief in Bashan, among the family heads, and nothing further is recorded about him.

jachin-2.title: Jachin
jachin-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
jachin-2.note: One of 4 men called Jachin. This one is a Levite from the exile and the return, named twice in 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah.

jada.title: Jada
jada.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jada.note: Onam's son and Shammai's brother, in the Jerahmeelite branch of Judah's family.

jahath.title: Jahath
jahath.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jahath.note: A Levite of Gershon's line in Chronicles. The name comes up often in the Levite genealogies, for men of both Gershon and Kohath.

jahath-3.title: Jahath
jahath-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jahath-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

jahaz.title: Jahaz
jahaz.note: Moses beat Sihon, the Amorite king, at Jahaz, on the plateau north of the Arnon. The town went to Reuben and then to the Merarite Levites, and because it changed hands with Moab more than once, Isaiah and Jeremiah both name it in their oracles against Moab.

jahdiel.title: Jahdiel
jahdiel.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jahdiel.note: One of the family heads of the half-tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan.

jahdo.title: Jahdo
jahdo.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jahdo.note: Buz's son and Jeshishai's father, in Gad's family east of the Jordan. Nothing further is known of him.

jahmai.title: Jahmai
jahmai.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jahmai.note: In David's day he headed a family in the house of Tolah, one of Issachar's clans of fighting men.

jahzerah.title: Jahzerah
jahzerah.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
jahzerah.note: A priest in the line of those who resettled Jerusalem, Meshullam's son and Adiel's father. Nehemiah's list calls him Ahzai.

jahziel.title: Jahziel
jahziel.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jahziel.note: Chronicles spells him this way. He is Naphtali's son, head of a clan, and Genesis and Numbers call him Jahzeel.

jair.title: Jair
jair.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jair.note: He judged Israel twenty-two years. His thirty sons rode thirty donkeys and held thirty towns, which says money and reach, not battles won.

jakim-2.title: Jakim
jakim-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jakim-2.note: A Benjamite family head living in Jerusalem, in the Chronicles genealogy.

jalam.title: Jalam
jalam.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
jalam.note: Esau's son by Oholibamah, whose descendants became one of Edom's clans.

jalon.title: Jalon
jalon.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jalon.note: Last of the four sons of Ezra in Judah's genealogy, and nothing further is known of him.

jamin-2.title: Jamin
jamin-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jamin-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

jamin.title: Jamin
jamin.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jamin.note: One of Simeon's sons, in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers and Chronicles. The name was common.

jamlech.title: Jamlech
jamlech.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jamlech.note: A chief of Simeon's clans. Nothing else is recorded about him.

japheth.title: Japheth
japheth.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
japheth.note: Noah's son. With Shem he covered their drunken father without looking, and Noah asked God to enlarge Japheth's territory. Genesis 10 traces his descendants to the peoples of Asia Minor and the Aegean.

japhia.title: Japhia
japhia.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
japhia.note: Born to David in Jerusalem, and sharing his name with a king of Lachish and a town of Zebulun.

japhlet.title: Japhlet
japhlet.note: From Asher through Beriah, and head of the Japhletite clan. Nothing else is known of him.

jarah.title: Jarah
jarah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jarah.note: Saul's line runs through Jonathan and Mephibosheth to Micah, and Jarah is Micah's son. The other copy of the list calls him Jehoadah.

jared.title: Jared
jared.about: Man living at the time before the Flood
jared.note: Enoch's father, in Seth's line down to Noah, and he lived nine hundred sixty-two years.

jaresiah.title: Jaresiah
jaresiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jaresiah.note: A Benjamite family head, descended from Jeroham.

jarha.title: Jarha
jarha.about: Egyptian living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jarha.note: Sheshan had no sons. He gave his daughter to Jarha, his Egyptian servant, to keep the line going. Their descendants run on for generations in Chronicles.

jarib.title: Jarib
jarib.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jarib.note: Ezra sent a Jarib, one of the leaders, to recruit Levites for the return. Chronicles lists a second man of the name in a genealogy.

jaroah.title: Jaroah
jaroah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jaroah.note: They list him among the chiefs of Gad in Bashan, and nothing else is recorded of him.

jashub.title: Jashub
jashub.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jashub.note: Issachar's son, and his clan was counted in the census of Numbers.

jashubi-lehem.title: Jashubi-lehem
jashubi-lehem.note: Older dictionaries could not decide whether this is a man or a place, "those who returned to Lehem". It sits in the genealogy of Judah through Shelah, and modern translations mostly read it as a place.

jattir.title: Jattir
jattir.note: A priests' town in the hill country of Judah, given to Aaron's line. David sent its elders a share of the Amalekite plunder, as he did for many towns while he was on the run. It is identified with Khirbet Attir, south of Hebron.

javan.title: Javan
javan.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
javan.note: Japheth's fourth son in the table of nations. The Hebrews took his descendants to be the Ionians, the Greek world, and the prophets use Javan to mean Greece and its merchants. Modern Hebrew still calls Greece by the name.

jeaterai.title: Jeaterai
jeaterai.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeaterai.note: Zerah's son, a Gershonite Levite, in the genealogy of Chronicles. Nothing further is recorded of him.

jeconiah.title: Jeconiah
jeconiah.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeconiah.note: Another name for Jehoiachin, the king of Judah carried off to Babylon. In the end a Babylonian king let him out and gave him a seat at the royal table.

jedaiah.title: Jedaiah
jedaiah.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
jedaiah.note: The name was common among priests after the exile. Several who came back from Babylon and served in the rebuilt temple carried it.

jedaiah-5.title: Jedaiah
jedaiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jedaiah-5.note: Named once, in a family line in Chronicles, and not one of the priests who share the name.

jediael.title: Jediael
jediael.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jediael.note: A Benjamite clan head, whose family is counted among the fighting men in Chronicles.

jeduthun-2.title: Jeduthun
jeduthun-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
jeduthun-2.note: 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

jehalellel.title: Jehalellel
jehalellel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehalellel.note: The name means "praise God". This one is in Judah's genealogy; another was a Levite whose sons helped cleanse the temple under Hezekiah.

jehdai.title: Jehdai
jehdai.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jehdai.note: Six sons are credited to Jehdai in the genealogy of Judah, through Caleb's line.

jehiel-2.title: Jehiel
jehiel-2.note: Jeuel, in most translations. One man of the name lived in Jerusalem after the exile; another came back with Ezra.

jehoada.title: Jehoada
jehoada.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehoada.note: In Saul's line through Jonathan and Mephibosheth, the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth and Zimri. The other copy of the list calls him Jarah.

jehoiakim.title: Jehoiakim
jehoiakim.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehoiakim.note: Pharaoh Necho put him on Judah's throne. When Jeremiah's scroll was read to him, he cut it off a section at a time and burned it in the fire pot, while his advisors begged him to stop. Jeremiah had it written out again, with more added.

jehoiarib-2.title: Jehoiarib
jehoiarib-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
jehoiarib-2.note: He headed the first of the twenty-four priestly divisions, and the division outlasted the exile. Mattathias and his sons, the Maccabees, traced their family to it.

jehoshaphat.title: Jehoshaphat
jehoshaphat.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehoshaphat.note: A king of Judah who sent officials and Levites through the land to teach the law. His alliance with Israel kept going wrong, and in one battle enemy soldiers took him for Ahab and nearly killed him. When Moab, Ammon and Edom invaded together, he sent singers ahead of the army, and the invaders destroyed each other.

jehoshua.title: Jehoshua
jehoshua.about: Judge living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness and Conquest
jehoshua.note: Joshua, in the longer spelling. Moses's attendant and successor, and one of two from the generation out of Egypt who lived to enter the land. He took Israel over the Jordan, brought down Jericho and divided the land among the tribes. The name means Yahweh saves, the same name Greek renders Jesus.

jehozadek.title: Jehozadek
jehozadek.about: High Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
jehozadek.note: Jehozadak went into exile as high priest, and his son Joshua, or Jeshua, was high priest at the return and the rebuilding.

jehu-4.title: Jehu
jehu-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehu-4.note: One of 5 men called Jehu. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jehu-5.title: Jehu
jehu-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehu-5.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

jehubbah.title: Jehubbah
jehubbah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehubbah.note: From Asher through Beriah, named once. Nothing further is recorded of him.

jehudijah.title: Jehudijah
jehudijah.note: Not a name but a label, "the Jewess", on one of Mered's wives. Many think she is Bithiah, Pharaoh's daughter, named in the same verse.

jehush.title: Jehush
jehush.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
jehush.note: Esau's son, more often spelled Jeush. Several other men in Chronicles carry the name.

jehush-3.title: Jehush
jehush-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehush-3.note: One of 5 men called Jehush. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jehush-4.title: Jehush
jehush-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jehush-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

jeiel-3.title: Jeiel
jeiel-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeiel-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

jeiel.title: Jeiel
jeiel.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeiel.note: One of the temple musicians when the ark came up. The name turns up often in Chronicles, for singers, scribes and officials.

jekamiah.title: Jekamiah
jekamiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jekamiah.note: In Sheshan's line, the family that ran through a daughter's marriage to an Egyptian servant.

jekamiah-2.title: Jekamiah
jekamiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jekamiah-2.note: A descendant of Jeconiah in the royal line after the exile.

jekuthiel.title: Jekuthiel
jekuthiel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jekuthiel.note: Zanoah's founder, as the genealogies of Judah put it, counted among the children of Bithiah, Mered's Egyptian wife. Nothing further is recorded about him.

jephunneh.title: Jephunneh
jephunneh.about: Caleb's father living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jephunneh.note: Caleb's father, remembered almost entirely as a name in "Caleb son of Jephunneh", which is how the Old Testament tells that Caleb apart from the others.

jephunneh-2.title: Jephunneh
jephunneh-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jephunneh-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

jerah.title: Jerah
jerah.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
jerah.note: His name means "moon" in Hebrew. He was a son of Joktan, in Shem's line. An Arabian tribe came from him. Little else is known about it.

jerahmeel.title: Jerahmeel
jerahmeel.note: Judah's line ran down through Perez to him, and Chronicles keeps a long genealogy of his clan.

jeremiah-7.title: Jeremiah
jeremiah-7.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeremiah-7.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

jericho.title: Jericho
jericho.note: Israel crossed the Jordan and Jericho was the first city it took, walled and gated, with its own king. Achan died for what he stole from the plunder there, a Babylonian robe and silver that belonged to God. By then the place was already ancient: digging at the site has turned up remains about ten thousand years old.

jeriel.title: Jeriel
jeriel.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jeriel.note: Tola's line, in the tribe of Issachar, counted six family heads and fighting men in David's day. He was one of them.

jerioth.title: Jerioth
jerioth.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jerioth.note: Her place in Caleb's family is hard to pin down. The Hebrew of 1 Chronicles 2:18 leaves it unclear whether she was a second wife alongside Azubah or another name tied to the children Caleb had.

jermoth-5.title: Jermoth
jermoth-5.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jermoth-5.note: Named once, in a clan list in 1 Chronicles 7, as a family head. He is none of the musicians, warriors or men of Ezra's day who carry the same name.

jeroboam-2.title: Jeroboam
jeroboam-2.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeroboam-2.note: Jeroboam the second, king of Israel generations after the first Jeroboam. His reign was a time of unusual prosperity and military success for the north.

jeroham-2.title: Jeroham
jeroham-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
jeroham-2.note: 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

jeroham.title: Jeroham
jeroham.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
jeroham.note: Samuel's family line goes back through him: he was the prophet's great-grandfather's generation, in the genealogy that opens 1 Samuel and again in the Levitical lists of Chronicles.

jeroham-5.title: Jeroham
jeroham-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeroham-5.note: One of 7 men called Jeroham. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jeroham-6.title: Jeroham
jeroham-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jeroham-6.note: A man from the exile and the return, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

jerusalem.title: Jerusalem
jerusalem.note: David took it from the Jebusites and made it his capital, and once Solomon's temple stood there it was the centre of Israel's worship for a thousand years. Babylon destroyed it, the exiles rebuilt it, Rome destroyed it again in AD 70. Jesus died and rose just outside its walls, and Revelation ends with a new Jerusalem coming down from heaven.

jesher.title: Jesher
jesher.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jesher.note: First of three sons Chronicles gives to Caleb and Azubah. The same verse brings in Jerioth. So who his mother was is not quite settled.

jeshishai.title: Jeshishai
jeshishai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeshishai.note: A Gadite, in the family list of the settlers of Gilead, and that is all of him.

jeshoaiah.title: Jeshoaiah
jeshoaiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeshoaiah.note: Simeon had clan heads who pushed out the Hamites and Meunites to take more pastureland, and he is on the list. Nothing further is recorded about him.

jesimael.title: Jesimael
jesimael.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jesimael.note: A head of one of Simeon's clans, the men who drove out the Hamite people near Gedor and settled there.

jesse.title: Jesse
jesse.about: David's father living at the time of United Monarchy
jesse.note: Obed's son and Boaz and Ruth's grandson, a man of some standing in Bethlehem with eight sons, the youngest David. Isaiah's "stem of Jesse" is David's family, and the "root of Jesse" is the Messiah. The last we see of him, David is getting him a safe place with the king of Moab.

jether.title: Jether
jether.about: Ishmaelite living at the time of United Monarchy
jether.note: An Ishmaelite, by the record's own label, carrying a name several men shared. Exodus 4:18 uses it for Jethro, Moses's father-in-law, and Gideon's eldest son had it too, the boy too frightened to kill the captured Midianite kings.

jether-2.title: Jether
jether-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jether-2.note: One of 4 men called Jether. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

jether-3.title: Jether
jether-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jether-3.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

jetheth.title: Jetheth
jetheth.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
jetheth.note: Edom had clan chiefs who came down from Esau, and Jetheth is listed with them.

jetur.title: Jetur
jetur.about: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
jetur.note: He was Ishmael's son, and Chronicles records a war in which Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh beat his descendants.

jetur-2.title: Jetur
jetur-2.note: Named once, in 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

jeuz.title: Jeuz
jeuz.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeuz.note: Born in Moab, to Shaharaim, and later head of a family in Benjamin. Nothing further is recorded about him.

jezer.title: Jezer
jezer.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jezer.note: He was Naphtali's son. His family became one of Naphtali's clans.

jezliah.title: Jezliah
jezliah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jezliah.note: A Benjamite family head in Jerusalem, one of Elpaal's sons, and nothing else is recorded of him.

jezreel-3.title: Jezreel
jezreel-3.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jezreel-3.note: A man from the wilderness years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

jibsam.title: Jibsam
jibsam.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jibsam.note: He was one of Tola's sons, of Issachar, and the head of a fighting family in David's time.

joab.title: Joab
joab.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
joab.note: David's nephew, and the commander of his army for most of the reign. He was loyal to what David needed rather than what David said: he arranged Uriah's death when asked, killed Absalom when told not to, and murdered Abner and Amasa under cover of friendship. David never forgave Absalom. On David's word Solomon had Joab killed, even holding on to the altar.

joab-3.title: Joab
joab-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joab-3.note: One of 4 men called Joab. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

joah-3.title: Joah
joah-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joah-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

joash.title: Joash
joash.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joash.note: Seven years old when he was made king of Judah, after six years hidden in the temple from his grandmother Athaliah, who had killed the rest of the royal family. While Jehoiada the priest lived, Joash ruled well and repaired the temple. Afterwards he let it go, and when Jehoiada's son stood up to him he had the man stoned in the temple court. His own murder followed.

joash-7.title: Joash
joash-7.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
joash-7.note: A man from the wilderness years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

joash-8.title: Joash
joash-8.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
joash-8.note: Named once, in 1 Chronicles 7:8, in a list of brothers. He is neither of the kings.

jobab.title: Jobab
jobab.about: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
jobab.note: An early king of Edom, from the list in Genesis 36 of kings who ruled there before Israel had any.

jobab-3.title: Jobab
jobab-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jobab-3.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

jobab-4.title: Jobab
jobab-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jobab-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

jobab-2.title: Jobab
jobab-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
jobab-2.note: Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the patriarchs.

jobesh-gilead.title: Jobesh
jobesh-gilead.note: Better known as Jabesh-gilead, a town in Gilead east of the Jordan. Its men stayed home from the war against Benjamin and were nearly wiped out for it, and their daughters were handed to Benjamin's survivors as wives. When Nahash the Ammonite besieged it, Saul rescued it. Years later its men took his body down from the walls of Beth-shan and buried it.

joel.title: Joel
joel.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
joel.note: Samuel's son, and not the prophet. Chronicles puts him in the Levite lists, and he is the father in a line of temple singers.

joel-10.title: Joel
joel-10.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joel-10.note: One of 14 men called Joel. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles. The verse is 1 Chronicles 5:8.

joel-7.title: Joel
joel-7.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joel-7.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

joel-8.title: Joel
joel-8.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joel-8.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

joel-9.title: Joel
joel-9.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joel-9.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

joel-11.title: Joel
joel-11.about: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joel-11.note: A warrior from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

joha-2.title: Joha
joha-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
joha-2.note: They called him a Benjamite, Beriah's son, and he headed a family in Jerusalem. There is another Joha in Chronicles, one of David's mighty men, and nothing else tells the two apart.

johanan.title: Johanan
johanan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
johanan.note: He commanded troops after Jerusalem fell and warned Gedaliah, the new governor, that someone was coming to kill him. Gedaliah would not believe it, and the plot went through.

johanan-4.title: Johanan
johanan-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
johanan-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

johanan-2.title: Johanan
johanan-2.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
johanan-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a priest from the divided-kingdom years.

jokim.title: Jokim
jokim.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
jokim.note: Shelah's line, Judah's son, in a genealogy of 1 Chronicles 4:22.

jokmeam-2.title: Jokmeam
jokmeam-2.note: A Levitical town, probably in the Jordan valley near Ephraim, given with its pastureland to the Kohathites.

jokshan.title: Jokshan
jokshan.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
jokshan.note: He was Abraham's son by Keturah, and Sheba and Dedan, names tied to Arabian trading peoples, came from him.

joktan.title: Joktan
joktan.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
joktan.note: The father of a long list of Arabian peoples in Genesis, and Eber's son. His brother Peleg's line is the one that leads to Abraham.

jonathan.title: Jonathan
jonathan.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
jonathan.note: Saul's eldest son, heir to the throne, and David's friend. He made a covenant with David knowing it cost him the crown. Once, with only his armour-bearer, he climbed a cliff and started a rout of the Philistine army. He died with Saul and two brothers on Mount Gilboa, and David's lament for him says his love was "surpassing the love of women."

jonathan-4.title: Jonathan
jonathan-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jonathan-4.note: Named in a family list in 1 Chronicles 2, with his sons after him, and that is all.

jorai.title: Jorai
jorai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jorai.note: Gad's clans settled in Gilead and Bashan, and he was one of the leaders listed there in the record from the reigns of Jotham and Jeroboam II.

joram.title: Joram
joram.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joram.note: Another form of Jehoram, and the kings of Israel and Judah called by it are covered under that entry.

jordan.title: Jordan
jordan.note: It runs from the slopes of Mount Hermon through the Sea of Galilee and down the Rift Valley to the Dead Sea, about sixty five miles in a straight line and nearer two hundred as the river winds. Israel crossed it on dry ground under Joshua, Elijah and Elisha each parted it, and John the Baptist baptised Jesus in it.

jorkeam.title: Jorkeam
jorkeam.about: Man or town at the time of Divided Monarchy
jorkeam.note: In Caleb's genealogy, a descendant of Raham. The name probably stands for a town or clan this family founded, and nobody has found where it was.

joseph.title: Joseph
joseph.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
joseph.note: Jacob's eleventh son and Rachel's first. His father's favouritism and his own tactless dreams got him sold into Egypt by his brothers, and there he rose from slave to prisoner to second in the land by reading Pharaoh's dreams of famine. When the famine drove his brothers down for grain, he told them who he was and forgave them.

joshah.title: Joshah
joshah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
joshah.note: A chief of the tribe of Simeon. In Hezekiah's reign his family drove the Hamite and Meunite people out of a good valley near Gedor and took it for themselves.

josiah.title: Josiah
josiah.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
josiah.note: Made king of Judah at eight after his father Amon was murdered. In his eighteenth year workmen repairing the temple found a forgotten scroll of the law, and its reading set off Judah's last great reform: pagan altars torn down, the priests of the high places killed, and a Passover like none since the judges. He died young at Megiddo, trying to stop the Egyptian army reaching Assyria.

josibiah.title: Josibiah
josibiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
josibiah.note: Jehu's father. Jehu was one of the Simeonite family heads who pushed out the Hamite people of Gedor under Hezekiah, and nothing else is recorded about Josibiah himself.

jotham.title: Jotham
jotham.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jotham.note: He carried on his father Uzziah's steady rule in Judah, building up Jerusalem's defences and bringing the Ammonites under, and Scripture counts him one of the few kings who did right in the Lord's eyes. The high places stayed, though.

jotham-3.title: Jotham
jotham-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jotham-3.note: One of 3 men called Jotham. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

judah.title: Judah
judah.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
judah.note: Leah's fourth son, and the brother who ends up leading. He talked the others into selling Joseph rather than killing him, and later offered himself as a hostage in Benjamin's place. His tribe produced David's royal line and gave its name to the southern kingdom, and Jacob's dying blessing promised the sceptre would not leave him.

jushab-hesed.title: Jushab-hesed
jushab-hesed.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jushab-hesed.note: One of Zerubbabel's sons, in the royal genealogy of Judah after the exile.

kedar.title: Kedar
kedar.about: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
kedar.note: Ishmael's son, and the father of a desert tribe known for dark tents and good archers. Poets use Kedar for far-off wilderness living, and the Song of Solomon uses it for dark beauty.

kedemah.title: Kedemah
kedemah.about: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
kedemah.note: He was the youngest of Ishmael's twelve sons, and his name means "eastward," which suits sons who settled east of Canaan. Nothing else is recorded about him individually.

kedemoth.title: Kedemoth
kedemoth.note: A town in Reuben's land, given to the Merarite Levites. Moses sent messengers from its wilderness to Sihon, king of the Amorites, asking to pass through, and Sihon's refusal led to war.

kedesh.title: Kedesh
kedesh.note: A city of refuge in Galilee, one of six where someone who had killed by accident could run and be safe. Barak came from there, the commander Deborah called up.

keilah.title: Keilah
keilah.note: David saved this walled town from a Philistine raid while Saul was hunting him. Then he learned they would have handed him over if Saul came, and he moved on into the wilderness of Ziph.

kenath.title: Kenath
kenath.note: In Bashan, east of the Jordan, taken when Israel moved in and renamed Nobah after the man who took it. It is generally identified with Qanawat on the slopes of Jebel Hauran, where Roman ruins still stand, a theatre among them.

kenaz.title: Kenaz
kenaz.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
kenaz.note: One of Edom's clan chiefs, in Genesis 36 and again in Chronicles. The Kenizzites are counted among the Edomite clans.

kenaz-3.title: Kenaz
kenaz-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
kenaz-3.note: One of 3 men called Kenaz. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

kenaz-2.title: Kenaz
kenaz-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
kenaz-2.note: Caleb's younger brother, and father of Othniel, Israel's first judge.

kenite.title: Kenite
kenite.note: They were a wandering clan close to Midian, outside the twelve tribes but mostly friendly to Israel. Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, was a Kenite priest, and Jael, Heber the Kenite's wife, killed Sisera.

keturah.title: Keturah
keturah.about: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
keturah.note: The wife Abraham took after Sarah died. Her six sons became Arabian and Midianite peoples, and Abraham sent them away with gifts so Isaac would stand alone as heir.

kiriathaim-2.title: Kiriathaim
kiriathaim-2.note: Named once, in 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

kish.title: Kish
kish.about: Saul's father living at the time of United Monarchy
kish.note: Saul's father, a Benjamite of some standing. He lost his donkeys, sent Saul to find them, and the search ended with Samuel anointing Saul as Israel's first king.

kishi.title: Kishi
kishi.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
kishi.note: Kishi, or Kushaiah, was the Merarite Levite whose son Ethan was one of the three chief musicians David put to serve before the ark.

kishion-2.title: Kishion
kishion-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and nothing else is recorded.

kohath.title: Kohath
kohath.about: Levi's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
kohath.note: Levi's second son. His descendants had the holiest work in the tabernacle, carrying the ark and the sacred furniture on poles, and even they would die if they touched those things.

kohathites.title: Kohathites
kohathites.about: Levi's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
kohathites.note: One of the three Levitical divisions, descended from Kohath. They carried the holiest furnishings, the ark among them, on poles and not in a cart, and 2 Samuel 6 shows what happened when that rule was broken. They camped south of the tabernacle. Moses, Aaron and Samuel were all Kohathites.

korah.title: Korah
korah.about: Aaron's adversary living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
korah.note: A Levite who led a revolt against Moses and Aaron, with more than two hundred fifty leading Israelites behind him, all saying the whole community was holy and Moses had no special claim. The ground opened and took Korah and his family alive, and fire burned up the rest. Israel complained about it the very next day.

korah-2.title: Korah
korah-2.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
korah-2.note: An Edomite chief in Genesis 36 and Chronicles, with nothing to do with the Levite who rebelled.

korah-3.title: Korah
korah-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
korah-3.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

kore.title: Kore
kore.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
kore.note: There was a family of temple gatekeepers who traced themselves to him, and Chronicles names him at the head of their line.

koz.title: Koz
koz.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
koz.note: Ancestor of a priestly family that came back from exile and could not prove its descent, and until that was settled they were kept out of the priesthood.

laadah.title: Laadah
laadah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
laadah.note: Shelah's line, Judah's son, and the father of the clan at Mareshah.

laadan-2.title: Laadan
laadan-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
laadan-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

lahad.title: Lahad
lahad.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
lahad.note: One of Jahath's sons, in Judah's line through Shobal. Nothing else is recorded of him.

lamech.title: Lamech
lamech.about: Man living at the time before the Flood
lamech.note: Noah's father, from Seth's line. He named his son Noah in the hope that the boy would bring relief from farming the cursed ground. Luke's genealogy keeps him as one link in the chain.

lasharon.title: Lasharon
lasharon.note: "Belonging to Sharon." Joshua beat a king of Lasharon, but most of these verses are about the Sharon plain, the rich coast between Joppa and Mount Carmel, with royal pasture and some of Gad living there. Its beauty became a byword, "the rose of Sharon," and Isaiah pictures it blooming again.

lecah.title: Lecah
lecah.about: Man or town at the time of Divided Monarchy
lecah.note: Named once among the descendants of Shelah, Judah's son by Bath-shua, and probably a clan or the town it founded. Nothing further is known of it.

lehabim.title: Lehabim
lehabim.note: A people descended from Mizraim, the ancestor of Egypt, in the Table of Nations. The name is widely tied to the Lebu of Egyptian inscriptions, ancestors of the Libyans on the coast west of Egypt.

levi.title: Levi
levi.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
levi.note: Jacob's third son. He and Simeon massacred the men of Shechem after their sister Dinah was raped, and Jacob cursed them both for it on his deathbed. Even so, Levi's descendants became Israel's priestly tribe, given service at the tabernacle instead of land, partly for their zeal against the golden calf at Sinai.

libnah.title: Libnah
libnah.note: A royal Canaanite city near Lachish that Joshua took and gave to the Levites in Judah. It held out against Sennacherib's Assyrians. Hamutal, Josiah's wife and mother of two of Judah's last kings, came from there.

libni.title: Libni
libni.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
libni.note: Gershon's son, Levi's grandson, and the head of one of the Levitical clans.

libni-2.title: Libni
libni-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
libni-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the wilderness years.

likhi.title: Likhi
likhi.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
likhi.note: Shemidah's son, of Manasseh, and a family head in that tribe.

lod.title: Lod
lod.note: They called it Lydda in New Testament Greek. Over seven hundred people came back from exile to this town of Benjamin, on the plain along the road from Jerusalem to Joppa. Modern Lod, by Tel Aviv's airport, keeps the name.

lotan.title: Lotan
lotan.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
lotan.note: He was a Horite chief whose sister Timna made him Esau's brother-in-law, and his people were living in Edom's land before Edom.

lud.title: Lud
lud.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
lud.note: Shem's son. His people are usually taken to be the Lydians of Asia Minor. Some later passages may mean a people in Africa instead.

maachah-7.title: Maachah
maachah-7.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
maachah-7.note: A woman from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

maachah-3.title: Maachah
maachah-3.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
maachah-3.note: A woman from the wilderness years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

maachah-4.title: Maachah
maachah-4.about: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
maachah-4.note: A woman from the united kingdom. 1 Chronicles names him twice.

maachah-5.title: Maachah
maachah-5.about: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
maachah-5.note: One of 10 men called Maachah. This one is a woman from the united kingdom, named twice in 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles.

maachathite.title: Maachathite
maachathite.note: Someone from Maacah, the small Aramean kingdom near Mount Hermon that Israel never fully brought under. Eliphelet, one of David's officers, was a Maachathite.

maasiai.title: Maasiai
maasiai.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
maasiai.note: In the roll of 1 Chronicles 9, a priest who settled in Jerusalem after the exile in Babylon. Nothing further is known of him.

maaz.title: Maaz
maaz.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
maaz.note: Ram's son, a descendant of Judah, with brothers Jamin and Eker.

machbenah.title: Machbenah
machbenah.about: Woman or town of at the time of Divided Monarchy
machbenah.note: Sheva is said to have "fathered" it in Caleb's genealogy, which probably means he founded the settlement. Where it was is unknown.

machir.title: Machir
machir.about: Manasseh's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
machir.note: Manasseh's son. His clan, the Machirites, were such fighters that Machir's name can stand for the whole half-tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan.

madai.title: Madai
madai.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
madai.note: Japheth's son, and the ancestor of the Medes, who later joined Persia in taking Babylon.

madmannah.title: Madmannah
madmannah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
madmannah.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

magdiel.title: Magdiel
magdiel.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
magdiel.note: One of the chiefs of Edom descended from Esau, in the lists at Genesis 36:43 and 1 Chronicles 1:54. The name may mark a clan territory more than a single ruler.

magog-2.title: Magog
magog-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
magog-2.note: Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the patriarchs.

mahalaleel.title: Mahalaleel
mahalaleel.about: Man living at the time before the Flood
mahalaleel.note: Seth's line, on the way down to Noah, four generations before Enoch.

mahanaim.title: Mahanaim
mahanaim.note: "Two camps." Jacob met the angels of God here near the Jabbok River on his way home, and split his household in two before facing Esau. After Saul died, Ishbosheth ruled the northern tribes from Mahanaim while David held Hebron, and years later David fled there himself from Absalom and heard there that his son was dead.

mahath.title: Mahath
mahath.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mahath.note: A Kohathite Levite, named among the men who worked on cleaning out the temple.

mahlah-2.title: Mahlah
mahlah-2.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mahlah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a woman from the divided-kingdom years.

mahli.title: Mahli
mahli.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
mahli.note: Merari's son and Levi's grandson. His family became one of the Levitical clans with work at the tabernacle.

mahli-2.title: Mahli
mahli-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
mahli-2.note: A second Mahli, under Merari's line in the Levite lists of Chronicles, and nothing more is known of him.

malchiel.title: Malchiel
malchiel.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
malchiel.note: He was Asher's son, and his descendants made up one of the clans of Asher in the genealogies.

malchijah-3.title: Malchijah
malchijah-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
malchijah-3.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

malchijah.title: Malchijah
malchijah.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
malchijah.note: 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

malchiram.title: Malchiram
malchiram.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
malchiram.note: Born to King Jeconiah, also called Jehoiachin, during or after the family's time as captives in Babylon.

malchishua.title: Malchishua
malchishua.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
malchishua.note: One of Saul's sons, who died with his father and brothers when the Philistines beat Israel on Mount Gilboa.

malluch-2.title: Malluch
malluch-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
malluch-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

manahath-2.title: Manahath
manahath-2.note: Named once, in 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

manahath.title: Manahath
manahath.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
manahath.note: Shobal's son, Seir the Horite's grandson, and a clan chief of Edom in Genesis and Chronicles. The same name shows up in Benjamin's genealogy, probably for the related Manahathites, who are tied elsewhere to Zorah and Caleb's family.

manasseh.title: Manasseh
manasseh.about: Joseph's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
manasseh.note: Joseph's elder son, whom Jacob took as his own and blessed. His name went to one of Israel's twelve tribes, and from Numbers through Joshua and Chronicles most of his verses are about that tribe and its land.

manasseh-2.title: Manasseh
manasseh-2.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
manasseh-2.note: Hezekiah's son, who reigned in Judah longer than any king and did more harm than any. He rebuilt the high places, practiced sorcery, apparently sacrificed his own son, and filled Jerusalem with innocent blood. Chronicles says captivity in Babylon broke his pride and he repented, but his reforms died with him.

maon-2.title: Maon
maon-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
maon-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

mareshah-2.title: Mareshah
mareshah-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
mareshah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

mareshah-3.title: Mareshah
mareshah-3.about: Man or town at the time of Divided Monarchy
mareshah-3.note: One of 3 men called Mareshah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

mashal.title: Mashal
mashal.note: A Levitical town in Asher, somewhere on the coastal plain. Joshua calls it Mishal in one list and Misheal in another, and the exact site is lost.

masrekah.title: Masrekah
masrekah.note: Samlah came from this town in Edom. He was one of the kings who ruled there before Israel had a king of its own.

massa.title: Massa
massa.about: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
massa.note: Ishmael had twelve sons, each the head of an Arabian tribe, and Massa was one. Assyrian records of the eighth century BC name a nomad tribe called Mas'a in the same region, and many scholars take them for his descendants.

matred.title: Matred
matred.about: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
matred.note: Mezahab's daughter, and the mother of Mehetabel, who married Hadar, the last king of Edom in the Genesis list. Women are rare in those lists, and nothing more is said of her.

mattaniah.title: Mattaniah
mattaniah.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
mattaniah.note: Zedekiah's name before Nebuchadnezzar made him king and changed it.

mattithiah-n-2.title: Mattithiah. n
mattithiah-n-2.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
mattithiah-n-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

medan.title: Medan
medan.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
medan.note: Abraham's son by Keturah, and the father of an Arabian tribe counted with Midian east of Canaan.

megiddo.title: Megiddo
megiddo.note: It guarded the pass into the Jezreel Valley. A Canaanite royal city, it went to Manasseh and Solomon rebuilt it as a chariot city. Deborah and Barak beat Sisera on its plain, and King Josiah died there facing Pharaoh Necho, a death mourned so deeply it became proverbial. Thutmose III's siege of it around 1457 BC is carved in detail on the walls of Karnak.

mehetabeel.title: Mehetabeel
mehetabeel.about: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
mehetabeel.note: Wife of one of the early kings of Edom, in the king lists of Genesis and Chronicles.

mehir.title: Mehir
mehir.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mehir.note: Chelub's son, of Judah, in the genealogy at 1 Chronicles 4:11, and nothing more.

melech.title: Melech
melech.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
melech.note: Saul's house went on through Jonathan, Mephibosheth and Micah, and Melech was Micah's son. He appears only in Benjamin's genealogy in Chronicles.

meonothai.title: Meonothai
meonothai.note: Othniel's son, and Othniel was the judge and Caleb's younger brother. Meonothai fathered Ophrah, according to 1 Chronicles 4:14.

mephaath.title: Mephaath
mephaath.note: A Levitical city in Reuben's land, given to the Merarite Levites. By Jeremiah's time Moab held it, so it turns up in his oracle against Moab. The site east of the Jordan has not been pinned down.

meraioth.title: Meraioth
meraioth.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
meraioth.note: A priestly name that comes up in the high priest's family line, in Chronicles and in Ezra's own genealogy.

merari.title: Merari
merari.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
merari.note: Levi's third son. His descendants had the heavy parts of the tabernacle, the frames, bars, pillars and bases, which went by cart instead of being carried.

mered.title: Mered
mered.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mered.note: A man of Judah who married Bithiah, a daughter of Pharaoh, as well as a wife called "the Jewess." Towns and craftsmen were counted among his descendants in the genealogies of Chronicles.

meri-baal.title: Meri-baal
meri-baal.about: Jonathan's son living at the time of United Monarchy
meri-baal.note: Another spelling of Merib-baal, which is what Chronicles calls Jonathan's son Mephibosheth.

merib-baal.title: Merib-baal
merib-baal.about: Jonathan's son living at the time of United Monarchy
merib-baal.note: Jonathan's son in the Chronicles genealogies, the man Samuel calls Mephibosheth. The switch to bosheth, "shame," probably came from later unease with Baal, "lord," as part of a name.

mesech-2.title: Mesech
mesech-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
mesech-2.note: Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the patriarchs.

mesech-3.title: Mesech
mesech-3.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
mesech-3.note: One of 4 men called Mesech. This one is a man from the patriarchs, named once in 1 Chronicles.

mesha-2.title: Mesha
mesha-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mesha-2.note: A person, not a place, whatever the tag says. Shaharaim had him by his wife Hodesh, and he heads a Benjamite clan in 1 Chronicles 8:9.

mesha.title: Mesha
mesha.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
mesha.note: Caleb's eldest son, and the father of Ziph, in the genealogy of Judah.

meshelemiah.title: Meshelemiah
meshelemiah.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
meshelemiah.note: Head of a family of temple gatekeepers under David. The lot gave him the east gate, a post with some honour to it.

meshobab.title: Meshobab
meshobab.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
meshobab.note: A Simeonite family head. In Hezekiah's day his people pushed out the Hamites and Meunites near Gedor to get more pasture.

meshullam-6.title: Meshullam
meshullam-6.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-6.note: A levite from the exile and the return. 1 Chronicles names him once.

meshullam-3.title: Meshullam
meshullam-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
meshullam-3.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

meshullam-4.title: Meshullam
meshullam-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
