meshullam-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

meshullam-5.title: Meshullam
meshullam-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
meshullam-5.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

meshullam.title: Meshullam
meshullam.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam.note: Priests, Levites and officials all used this name after the exile. Several of them worked on Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah or in running the temple.

meshullam-7.title: Meshullam
meshullam-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-7.note: One of 20 men called Meshullam. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in 1 Chronicles.

meshullam-8.title: Meshullam
meshullam-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-8.note: A man from the exile and the return, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

methuselah.title: Methuselah
methuselah.about: Man living at the time before the Flood
methuselah.note: Enoch's son and Noah's grandfather. Genesis gives him nine hundred sixty-nine years, longer than anyone else in the Bible. By the numbers in Genesis 5 he dies the year of the flood, though the text never connects the two. A Book of Noah fragment has him travel to find Enoch when his newborn grandson does not look human.

mezahab.title: Mezahab
mezahab.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
mezahab.note: Matred's father. His great claim is a granddaughter, Mehetabel, who married Hadar, the last king of Edom in the Genesis list.

mibsam.title: Mibsam
mibsam.about: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
mibsam.note: Ishmael's son, in the lists of Genesis and Chronicles.

mibsam-2.title: Mibsam
mibsam-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mibsam-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

mibzar.title: Mibzar
mibzar.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
mibzar.note: "Fortress." One of the chiefs of Edom from Esau's line, and like several names in that list it probably stands for a clan territory or stronghold as much as a man.

micah-5.title: Micah
micah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
micah-5.note: One of 3 men called Micah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

micah-2.title: Micah
micah-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
micah-2.note: Not the prophet. This Micah is a name in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles 8 and 9, and that is all of him.

micha.title: Micha
micha.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
micha.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

michael-6.title: Michael
michael-6.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
michael-6.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

michael-4.title: Michael
michael-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
michael-4.note: One of 11 men called Michael. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

michael-5.title: Michael
michael-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
michael-5.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him. The verse is 1 Chronicles 5:14.

michael-7.title: Michael
michael-7.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
michael-7.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

michael-8.title: Michael
michael-8.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
michael-8.note: One of 11 men called Michael. This one is a man from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

michri.title: Michri
michri.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
michri.note: Uzzi's father, a Benjamite, among the family heads who settled in Jerusalem after the exile. Nothing more is written of him.

midian.title: Midian
midian.note: A people descended from Abraham through Keturah, and they keep turning up in different roles. Midianite traders bought Joseph. Moses found a home and a wife, Zipporah, in Midian. Later they oppressed Israel until Gideon beat them.

midian-2.title: Midian
midian-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
midian-2.note: Abraham's son by Keturah, the man the Midianites traced themselves back to.

mikloth.title: Mikloth
mikloth.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
mikloth.note: A man of the Benjamite family that settled in Gibeon, father of Shimeah, in the line that leads to King Saul.

miriam.title: Miriam
miriam.about: Moses' sister living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
miriam.note: Moses and Aaron's older sister, and a prophetess. She watched over the baby Moses in the reeds of the Nile, and after the crossing of the sea she led Israel's women in song.

miriam-2.title: Miriam
miriam-2.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
miriam-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a woman from the divided-kingdom years.

mirma.title: Mirma
mirma.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mirma.note: Shaharaim's son, a Benjamite chief born in Moab, which suggests some Benjamites lived there for a while.

misham.title: Misham
misham.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
misham.note: Elpaal's son, a Benjamite in 1 Chronicles 8, and that is all.

mishma-2.title: Mishma
mishma-2.about: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
mishma-2.note: One of Ishmael's sons, from whom one of Ishmael's twelve tribes came, a set of twelve to match Israel's.

mishma.title: Mishma
mishma.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
mishma.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

mishraites.title: Mishraites
mishraites.note: One of the families that came out of the clans of Kiriath-jearim, named with the Ithrites, Puhites and Shumathites in 1 Chronicles 2:53.

mizzah.title: Mizzah
mizzah.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
mizzah.note: A clan chief of Edom, from Esau's line, and the record has no more.

moab.title: Moab
moab.note: East of the Dead Sea, the nation descended from Lot through his elder daughter. Israel and Moab went back and forth between enemies and kin: Balak hired Balaam to curse Israel, and yet Ruth, a Moabite, became King David's great-grandmother. King Mesha's own inscription on the Moabite Stone records the wars with Israel that 2 Kings describes.

moladah.title: Moladah
moladah.note: In the Negev. Judah was given it first, then Simeon, whose land sat inside Judah's, and people moved back there after the exile. It is often placed at Tel Malhata, east of Beersheba.

molid.title: Molid
molid.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
molid.note: Abishur and Abihail's son, of Jerahmeel's line in Judah.

moses.title: Moses
moses.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
moses.note: Born a Hebrew slave in Egypt and raised in Pharaoh's house, he killed an Egyptian overseer and ran to Midian, where he kept sheep for forty years. God called him back from the burning bush to face Pharaoh and lead Israel out. He gave them the law at Sinai, led them forty years in the wilderness, and died at a hundred and twenty within sight of the promised land.

moza.title: Moza
moza.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
moza.note: A descendant of Saul in the genealogies of Chronicles, a name also found in Caleb's family.

moza-2.title: Moza
moza-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
moza-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

mushi.title: Mushi
mushi.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
mushi.note: Merari's son and Levi's grandson. His family became one of the Levitical clans serving at the tabernacle.

naam.title: Naam
naam.note: Caleb son of Jephunneh had a son named Naam. He gets one mention, in the genealogy of Judah.

naaman-2.title: Naaman
naaman-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
naaman-2.note: Numbers and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

naaman-3.title: Naaman
naaman-3.note: A man from the years before the monarchy, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

naarah.title: Naarah
naarah.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
naarah.note: Ashur's second wife, in Hezron's line of Judah, and the mother of four of his sons.

naaran.title: Naaran
naaran.note: A town of Ephraim near the border with Benjamin, linked with Jericho. It is generally taken as the Naarah of Joshua 16:7 and placed a few miles north of Jericho.

naashon.title: Naashon
naashon.note: Leader of Judah in the wilderness years, and Aaron's brother-in-law. David came from his line, and so does Jesus in Matthew's genealogy.

nadab-3.title: Nadab
nadab-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
nadab-3.note: One of 4 men called Nadab. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named twice in 1 Chronicles.

nadab-4.title: Nadab
nadab-4.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
nadab-4.note: A man from the united kingdom, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

nadab.title: Nadab
nadab.about: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
nadab.note: Aaron's eldest son. He and his brother Abihu offered unauthorised fire before the Lord and were struck dead.

naham.title: Naham
naham.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
naham.note: The brother of Hodiah's wife, in a tangled verse of Judah's genealogy that translations parse in different ways.

nahath.title: Nahath
nahath.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
nahath.note: An Edomite chief from Esau's line. The name was also carried by a Levite in Chronicles.

nahor-2.title: Nahor
nahor-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
nahor-2.note: Terah's father, Abraham's grandfather, in the line from Shem. Joshua remembers that this family served other gods beyond the river.

naphish.title: Naphish
naphish.about: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
naphish.note: Ishmael's son. His people are among the tribes Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh beat in a war that Chronicles records.

naphtali.title: Naphtali
naphtali.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
naphtali.note: Jacob's sixth son, born to Rachel's servant Bilhah. His tribe settled in northern Galilee, the land Isaiah says will see a great light, and Matthew ties that to Jesus starting his work there.

naptuhim.title: Naptuhim
naptuhim.note: One of the peoples descended from Mizraim, that is Egypt, in the Table of Nations. Some put them in Lower Egypt or the Nile Delta, but there is no agreement.

nathan-2.title: Nathan
nathan-2.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
nathan-2.note: One of David's sons born in Jerusalem. Luke traces Jesus' line through him, not through Solomon.

nathan-4.title: Nathan
nathan-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
nathan-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

neariah.title: Neariah
neariah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
neariah.note: A descendant of David in the royal line Chronicles carries on past the exile.

neariah-2.title: Neariah
neariah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
neariah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

nebaioth.title: Nebaioth
nebaioth.about: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
nebaioth.note: Ishmael's firstborn. His descendants were an Arabian trading people, named next to Kedar in Isaiah.

nebo.title: Nebo
nebo.note: The mountain in Moab where Moses looked over the promised land before he died, taken as Jebel Neba on the ridge of Pisgah east of the Dead Sea. A Reubenite town nearby had the same name, and the oracles against Moab condemn it.

nebuchadnezzar.title: Nebuchadnezzar
nebuchadnezzar.about: Emperor living at the time of Divided Monarchy
nebuchadnezzar.note: King of Babylon. He destroyed Jerusalem and its temple in 586 BC and carried Judah off, and the Bible still calls him the tool God used to judge his people. Daniel tells how, after boasting of his greatness, he went mad and lived like an animal for seven years, until he gave God the glory and got his throne back.

nedabiah.title: Nedabiah
nedabiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
nedabiah.note: Jeconiah's son, born before or during the king's exile in Babylon. The royal list in 1 Chronicles 3:18 is the only place he appears.

nemuel.title: Nemuel
nemuel.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
nemuel.note: In the Numbers 26 census, a Nemuel is counted in Reuben's line, and the clan record says nothing more.

nepheg.title: Nepheg
nepheg.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
nepheg.note: One of David's sons born in Jerusalem, and nothing more is told of him.

ner.title: Ner
ner.about: Saul's uncle living at the time of United Monarchy
ner.note: Father of Abner, Saul's army commander. Ner was Saul's grandfather or great-uncle, depending on how the genealogies are fitted together.

nethaneel-3.title: Nethaneel
nethaneel-3.about: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
nethaneel-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the united kingdom.

nethinims.title: Nethinims
nethinims.note: Temple servants, probably war captives to begin with, given the heavy work around the Levites. Groups of them come back from Babylon in the return lists.

netophathite.title: Netophathite
netophathite.note: From Netophah, a small town near Bethlehem. Several of David's mighty men carried the name, and later some Levitical singers did too.

nimrod.title: Nimrod
nimrod.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
nimrod.note: Noah's great-grandson through Ham, called a mighty hunter before the Lord. Genesis credits him with founding a run of Mesopotamian cities, Babel among them. Micah later uses his name for the land of Assyria itself.

noah.title: Noah
noah.about: Flood survivor living at the time before the Flood
noah.note: God picked him as the one righteous man of his generation and told him to build an ark. His family came through the flood with him, along with pairs of every kind of animal. Afterward God made a covenant with him.

nodab.title: Nodab
nodab.about: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
nodab.note: A tribal group, not a single man, descended from Ishmael. Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh went to war against them, according to 1 Chronicles 5:19.

nogah.title: Nogah
nogah.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
nogah.note: Born to David in Jerusalem after he became king there. He is on two lists of David's sons and nowhere else.

nohah.title: Nohah
nohah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
nohah.note: Listed as Benjamin's fourth son in 1 Chronicles 8:2, though the lists in Genesis and Numbers do not have him. Nothing more is known.

non.title: Non
non.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
non.note: Joshua's father, of the tribe of Ephraim, more usually spelled Nun and hardly ever seen outside the phrase "Joshua son of Nun."

obadiah-3.title: Obadiah
obadiah-3.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
obadiah-3.note: One of 12 men called Obadiah. This one is a Levite from the exile and the return, named twice in 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah.

obadiah-2.title: Obadiah
obadiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
obadiah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

obadiah-6.title: Obadiah
obadiah-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
obadiah-6.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

obadiah-7.title: Obadiah
obadiah-7.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
obadiah-7.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

obed-2.title: Obed
obed-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
obed-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

obed.title: Obed
obed.note: Boaz and Ruth's son, and Naomi helped raise him. He was David's grandfather, which puts Ruth's story inside the royal line.

ohel.title: Ohel
ohel.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ohel.note: One of Zerubbabel's sons, in the list at 1 Chronicles 3:20, and nothing further.

omar.title: Omar
omar.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
omar.note: Esau's grandson and an Edomite clan chief, listed in the genealogies of Genesis 36.

omri-3.title: Omri
omri-3.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
omri-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

omri-4.title: Omri
omri-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
omri-4.note: One of 4 men called Omri. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in 1 Chronicles.

onam-2.title: Onam
onam-2.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
onam-2.note: A Horite clan name in Edom's genealogies, listed in Genesis 36:23 and again in 1 Chronicles 1:40.

onam.title: Onam
onam.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
onam.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the united kingdom.

onan.title: Onan
onan.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
onan.note: Judah's second son. Custom required him to father a child for his dead brother through the widow Tamar. He made sure it never happened, and God put him to death for it.

ono.title: Ono
ono.note: Nehemiah's enemies Sanballat and Tobiah asked him four times to come down and meet them in the plain of Ono, and he would not go. The town belonged to Benjamin, in a fertile plain northwest of Jerusalem, and returning exiles settled it again.

ophir-2.title: Ophir
ophir-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
ophir-2.note: Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the patriarchs.

ophrah-3.title: Ophrah
ophrah-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ophrah-3.note: One of 3 men called Ophrah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

oren.title: Oren
oren.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
oren.note: In the genealogy of Judah he is one of Jerahmeel's sons (1 Chronicles 2:25). Nothing further is known about him.

othniel.title: Othniel
othniel.note: Caleb's younger relative, who won Caleb's daughter Achsah by taking a Canaanite city. He became Israel's first judge and broke eight years of oppression under a Mesopotamian king.

ozem.title: Ozem
ozem.about: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
ozem.note: David's older brother, the sixth of Jesse's sons (1 Chronicles 2:15).

ozem-2.title: Ozem
ozem-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ozem-2.note: A son of Jerahmeel in Judah's genealogy, named once.

pai.title: Pai
pai.note: Hadar, last of Edom's early kings in the Genesis list, ruled from Pai, also spelled Pau, and nobody knows where in Edom it stood.

pallu.title: Pallu
pallu.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
pallu.note: Reuben's son. His descendants, the Palluites, were one of the clans counted in the wilderness.

pasach.title: Pasach
pasach.note: A son of Japhlet, in Asher's genealogy (1 Chronicles 7:33), and nothing more.

paseah-2.title: Paseah
paseah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
paseah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

pashur.title: Pashur
pashur.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
pashur.note: His name heads a family that came back from exile, counted in Ezra 2:38 and Nehemiah 7:41. He is not the temple official who had Jeremiah beaten; that man has his own entry.

pathrusim.title: Pathrusim
pathrusim.note: Descendants of Mizraim, named after Pathros, the country along the Nile south of Memphis.

pedaiah.title: Pedaiah
pedaiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
pedaiah.note: In the royal line after the exile, named in 1 Chronicles 3:18-19 in the same breath as Zerubbabel.

pelaiah-2.title: Pelaiah
pelaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
pelaiah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

pelatiah-2.title: Pelatiah
pelatiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
pelatiah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

pelatiah-3.title: Pelatiah
pelatiah-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
pelatiah-3.note: One of 4 men called Pelatiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

peleg.title: Peleg
peleg.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
peleg.note: In his days the earth was divided, Genesis says. That is usually taken to mean the scattering at Babel. He came down from Shem.

pelet-2.title: Pelet
pelet-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
pelet-2.note: A descendant of Judah through Jahdai, in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles 2:47.

peleth.title: Peleth
peleth.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
peleth.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

peniel.title: Peniel
peniel.note: Jacob wrestled here through the night by the Jabbok River. He came away with a new name, Israel, and a limp he kept. He called the place Peniel, face of God, because he had seen God face to face and lived.

peresh.title: Peresh
peresh.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
peresh.note: A son of Machir by his wife Maachah, with a brother named Sheresh, and that is the whole record.

perez.title: Perez
perez.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
perez.note: Judah's son by Tamar. He pushed out ahead of his twin Zerah, though Zerah's hand had already been marked with a scarlet thread as the firstborn. His line runs through Boaz to David.

pharaoh-7.title: Pharaoh
pharaoh-7.note: One of 8 men called Pharaoh. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

philistine.title: Philistine
philistine.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
philistine.note: Seafaring people who settled the coastal plain between Gezer and Gaza, most likely from Caphtor, which the Old Testament elsewhere identifies as Crete.

phinehas.title: Phinehas
phinehas.about: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
phinehas.note: Aaron's grandson, Eleazar's son. When Israel was being struck by a plague for idolatry and sexual sin with Moabite women, Phinehas drove a spear through an Israelite man and a Midianite woman together, and the plague stopped.

phut-2.title: Phut
phut-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
phut-2.note: Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the patriarchs.

phuvah.title: Phuvah
phuvah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
phuvah.note: Issachar's son, usually spelled Puvah, in the genealogies of Genesis and Numbers.

pinon.title: Pinon
pinon.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
pinon.note: An Edomite chief in Genesis 36:41 and 1 Chronicles 1:52, whom many scholars take to be the same name as Punon.

pispah.title: Pispah
pispah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
pispah.note: A son of Jether, among the family heads and warriors of Asher, with nothing else recorded of him.

pithon.title: Pithon
pithon.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
pithon.note: In the line of King Saul that runs through Jonathan, Pithon is a son of Micah and a grandson of Mephibosheth.

pul.title: Pul
pul.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
pul.note: Another Old Testament name for the Assyrian king Tiglath-pileser the Third, the one Menahem of Israel paid off to keep his own throne.

raamah.title: Raamah
raamah.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
raamah.note: His sons Sheba and Dedan fathered Arabian trading peoples. Raamah himself was a son of Cush, and Ezekiel lists Raamah's merchants among those who brought Tyre its spices and precious stones.

raddai.title: Raddai
raddai.about: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
raddai.note: The fifth of Jesse's seven sons, so one of David's brothers, and named in a single verse.

raguel.title: Raguel
raguel.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
raguel.note: In Genesis 36 he is an Edomite chief. The record elsewhere ties the name to Jethro, Moses's father-in-law, the Midianite priest, but these verses are the Edomite.

raguel-4.title: Raguel
raguel-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
raguel-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

raham.title: Raham
raham.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
raham.note: A descendant of Caleb through Hebron, in Judah's genealogies at 1 Chronicles 2:44.

ram.title: Ram
ram.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ram.note: In the line from Judah through Perez to Boaz, and on through Matthew's genealogy to David and Jesus.

ram-2.title: Ram
ram-2.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
ram-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the united kingdom.

ramoth.title: Ramoth
ramoth.note: Ramoth in Gilead, one of the cities of refuge east of the Jordan. Israel and Aram fought over it again and again. Ahab took his death wound there in disguise, and later Jehu was anointed king in the same place.

rapha-2.title: Rapha
rapha-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
rapha-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

rapha.title: Rapha
rapha.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
rapha.note: Ancestor of a clan of giants, and the Samuel narrative ties Goliath's kin to him.

reaia-2.title: Reaia
reaia-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
reaia-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

reaia-3.title: Reaia
reaia-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
reaia-3.note: One of 3 men called Reaia. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

rechab.title: Rechab
rechab.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
rechab.note: His son Jehonadab laid down a rule his descendants kept for generations: no wine, no permanent houses. Jeremiah held the Rechabites up as a rebuke to Judah.

rechah-2.title: Rechah
rechah-2.note: Named once, in 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

regem.title: Regem
regem.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
regem.note: A son of Jahdai, in Judah's genealogy through the line of Caleb, and nothing more is known of him.

rehob.title: Rehob
rehob.note: The far edge of the spies' route into Canaan, up in the north. Asher was allotted a Rehob too, and Judges 1:31 says Asher never drove out the people living there.

rehoboam.title: Rehoboam
rehoboam.about: King living at the time of United Monarchyand Divided Monarchy
rehoboam.note: Solomon's son, and he lost most of the kingdom in his first days on the throne. The northern tribes asked him to lighten the heavy labour his father had laid on them. He turned down the older advisers and threatened them with worse.

rehoboth.title: Rehoboth
rehoboth.note: It means broad places, and the name turns up in more than one spot. Genesis 10:11 puts a Rehoboth among the cities built in Assyria, and an Edomite king came from a Rehoboth by the river.

rekem-2.title: Rekem
rekem-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
rekem-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

rekem.title: Rekem
rekem.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
rekem.note: One of the five Midianite kings Israel killed in the days of Moses. The same name belongs to a man in Manasseh's genealogy.

remeth.title: Remeth
remeth.note: Named once, in 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

remmon-4.title: Remmon
remmon-4.note: Named twice, in Joshua and 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

remmon-3.title: Remmon
remmon-3.note: A town in the far south, named in the town lists of Joshua 15:32 and 19:7 and again in 1 Chronicles 4:32.

rephah.title: Rephah
rephah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
rephah.note: Listed in the genealogy of Ephraim, on the line that comes down several generations later to Joshua son of Nun.

rephaiah.title: Rephaiah
rephaiah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
rephaiah.note: The name of a descendant of David in the royal genealogy. It is common after the exile.

rephaiah-2.title: Rephaiah
rephaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
rephaiah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

rephaiah-3.title: Rephaiah
rephaiah-3.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
rephaiah-3.note: One of 4 men called Rephaiah. This one is a man from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

resheph.title: Resheph
resheph.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
resheph.note: A son of Ephraim, in 1 Chronicles 7:25. The name is also a Canaanite god of plague and war. Nothing suggests a connection.

reu.title: Reu
reu.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
reu.note: Between Noah's family and Abraham the genealogy runs through Reu, a descendant of Shem.

reuben.title: Reuben
reuben.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
reuben.note: Jacob's firstborn. He slept with one of his father's concubines and lost the birthright for it, and Jacob had not forgotten it on his deathbed.

rezia.title: Rezia
rezia.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
rezia.note: An Asherite, of the family of Ulla, among the heads of families in 1 Chronicles 7:39.

rinnah.title: Rinnah
rinnah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
rinnah.note: One of the sons of Shimon, in Judah's line.

rohgah.title: Rohgah
rohgah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
rohgah.note: An Asherite, son of Shamer, whom 1 Chronicles 7 counts among Asher's mighty men of valour.

sabta.title: Sabta
sabta.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
sabta.note: A son of Cush and grandson of Ham, also spelled Sabtah, and ancestor of a people among the early tribes of Arabia or northeast Africa.

sabtecha.title: Sabtecha
sabtecha.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
sabtecha.note: Cush's fifth son, listed with Seba, Havilah, Sabtah and Raamah in the table of nations. Like his brothers' names, his almost certainly stands for a people.

salah.title: Salah
salah.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
salah.note: Son of Arphaxad and father of Eber. He is a link in the chain from Noah to Abraham.

salcah.title: Salcah
salcah.note: The eastern edge of Israelite settlement. Salcah was a city of Bashan, given to the half tribe of Manasseh once Og, king of Bashan, was beaten.

sallai.title: Sallai
sallai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sallai.note: A common name after the exile, and this one turns up in Nehemiah's lists of the families who came back.

salma.title: Salma
salma.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
salma.note: Son of Nahshon and father of Boaz, the same man Ruth and Matthew call Salmon. Chronicles lists him in the line of Judah.

samlah.title: Samlah
samlah.about: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
samlah.note: Edom had kings before Israel did, and Samlah was one of them.

samuel.title: Samuel
samuel.about: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
samuel.note: Hannah prayed for a son and gave him to the Lord before he was born. He grew up to be the last of the judges and the first great prophet. Israel's first two kings were both anointed by him.

sarah-2.title: Sarah
sarah-2.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
sarah-2.note: Not Abraham's wife but a different woman, named in the family lists at Genesis 46:17, Numbers 26:46 and 1 Chronicles 7:30, from the years in Egypt and the wilderness.

saraph.title: Saraph
saraph.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
saraph.note: Ruled in Moab once, according to a line in Judah's genealogy that never says how. That is 1 Chronicles 4:22, and nothing more is recorded about him.

saul.title: Saul
saul.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
saul.note: Israel's first king, found while he was out looking for his father's lost donkeys and anointed by Samuel in private before the tribes confirmed him.

seba.title: Seba
seba.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
seba.note: Son of Cush, whose descendants the Psalms put with Sheba, a far kingdom in Africa or Arabia bringing tribute to Israel's king.

segub.title: Segub
segub.note: Named in 1 Chronicles 2:21 and 2:22, in a family list from before the monarchy, and that is all of him.

seir.title: Seir
seir.note: A rough range of mountains east of the Arabah. It runs from the bottom of the Dead Sea toward the Gulf of Aqabah. The Horites lived there first, and Esau's descendants pushed them out.

seir-2.title: Seir
seir-2.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
seir-2.note: Seir the Horite, whose sons are listed in Genesis 36:20 and again in 1 Chronicles 1:38. They were the people in the land before Esau's line took it.

seled.title: Seled
seled.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
seled.note: He died without children, according to Judah's genealogy, which traces him back to Jerahmeel through Nadab (1 Chronicles 2:30).

senazar.title: Senazar
senazar.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
senazar.note: Son of Jeconiah, the exiled king also called Jehoiachin. He is in David's royal line in 1 Chronicles 3:18.

senir.title: Senir
senir.note: The Amorite name for Mount Hermon. Ezekiel mentions its fir trees, which went into the ships of Tyre.

seraiah.title: Seraiah
seraiah.about: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
seraiah.note: The chief priest in Jerusalem when it fell. Nebuchadnezzar had him executed, and the name runs on through several later generations of priests.

seraiah-6.title: Seraiah
seraiah-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
seraiah-6.note: One of 8 men called Seraiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

seraiah-3.title: Seraiah
seraiah-3.note: A man from the years before the monarchy, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

serug.title: Serug
serug.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
serug.note: Abraham's great-grandfather, a descendant of Shem, on the line that joins Noah's family to the patriarchs.

seth.title: Seth
seth.about: Man living at the time before the Flood
seth.note: After Cain killed Abel, Eve had a third son. She named him Seth, saying God had given her another child in Abel's place. His line is the one Genesis follows forward.

shaaph.title: Shaaph
shaaph.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shaaph.note: Caleb's genealogy in Chronicles has two men by this name. This one is a son of Jahdai, in 1 Chronicles 2:47, and nothing else is recorded about him.

shaaph-2.title: Shaaph
shaaph-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shaaph-2.note: A son Caleb had by his concubine Maacah.

shachia.title: Shachia
shachia.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shachia.note: Born in Moab, a son of Shaharaim by his wife Hodesh, and listed among the heads of families in Benjamin's genealogy.

shaharaim.title: Shaharaim
shaharaim.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shaharaim.note: A Benjamite who sent away two wives, Hushim and Baara. Later, in Moab, he had children by his wife Hodesh. Their descendants are listed among the heads of families back in Benjamite land.

shallum.title: Shallum
shallum.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
shallum.note: He is a Levite of the years after the exile, named at 1 Chronicles 9:17, 9:19 and 9:31 in the lists of those who kept the gates.

shallum-4.title: Shallum
shallum-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shallum-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him twice.

shallum-6.title: Shallum
shallum-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shallum-6.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

shallum-7.title: Shallum
shallum-7.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shallum-7.note: One of 13 men called Shallum. This one is a man from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

shallum-3.title: Shallum
shallum-3.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shallum-3.note: A priest on the line that comes down to Ezra. He appears in 1 Chronicles 6:12 and 6:13 and again in Ezra 7:2.

shalthiel.title: Shalthiel
shalthiel.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shalthiel.note: Zerubbabel's father. He came from the exiled king Jehoiachin, so through him David's royal line can be traced through the Babylonian captivity.

shamer.title: Shamer
shamer.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shamer.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

shamer-3.title: Shamer
shamer-3.note: A name carried by a Levite, and by the mother of one of the men who assassinated King Joash.

shamma.title: Shamma
shamma.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shamma.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

shammah.title: Shammah
shammah.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
shammah.note: Genesis 36 has a Shammah among its chiefs, and 1 Samuel 16:9 and 17:13 name one as a brother of David. The name was used more than once.

shammai.title: Shammai
shammai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shammai.note: The name is common in Judah's genealogies, and this Shammai is on the Jerahmeelite line in 1 Chronicles 2:28 and 2:32.

shammai-2.title: Shammai
shammai-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shammai-2.note: A name in Judah's genealogy, among the Jerahmeelite clans, and nothing more.

shammai-3.title: Shammai
shammai-3.note: One of 3 men called Shammai. This one is a man from the years before the monarchy, named once in 1 Chronicles.

shamsherai.title: Shamsherai
shamsherai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shamsherai.note: A Benjamite, one of Jeroham's descendants in 1 Chronicles 8:26. Nothing else is recorded about him.

shapham.title: Shapham
shapham.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shapham.note: Second among the heads of Gad, the tribe that settled in Bashan east of the Jordan.

shaphat-3.title: Shaphat
shaphat-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shaphat-3.note: One of 5 men called Shaphat. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

shaphat-4.title: Shaphat
shaphat-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shaphat-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

sharesh.title: Sharesh
sharesh.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
sharesh.note: A son of Machir and Maachah, and Peresh's brother, in Manasseh's genealogy. Some versions spell it Sheresh.

sharuhen.title: Sharuhen
sharuhen.note: Named once, in 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

shashak.title: Shashak
shashak.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shashak.note: A Benjamite whose sons are listed among the family heads in Jerusalem.

shaul.title: Shaul
shaul.about: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
shaul.note: A king from the patriarchs. Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him 4 times.

shaul-3.title: Shaul
shaul-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shaul-3.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

shaul-2.title: Shaul
shaul-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shaul-2.note: Genesis and 3 other books name him 4 times, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

sheariah.title: Sheariah
sheariah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
sheariah.note: One of Saul's descendants through Jonathan's son Merib-baal, kept in the Chronicles genealogy of Saul's line. Nothing further is recorded about him.

sheba-6.title: Sheba
sheba-6.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
sheba-6.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

sheba-3.title: Sheba
sheba-3.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
sheba-3.note: A name among the nations in Genesis 10:7 and 1 Chronicles 1:9. Job 1:15 has raiders from Sheba carrying off Job's oxen and killing his servants.

sheba-4.title: Sheba
sheba-4.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
sheba-4.note: One of 4 men called Sheba. This one is a man from the patriarchs, named twice in Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

sheba-5.title: Sheba
sheba-5.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
sheba-5.note: A man from the patriarchs, named twice across Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

sheber.title: Sheber
sheber.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
sheber.note: Caleb had him by his concubine Maacah, and he is listed in Judah's genealogy.

shecaniah.title: Shecaniah
shecaniah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shecaniah.note: A name in the royal line after the exile, at 1 Chronicles 3:21 and 3:22. Nehemiah 12:3 has a priest who carried it.

shechem.title: Shechem
shechem.note: Abram stopped here when he first came into the land, and Joseph's brothers were grazing the flocks near it when Joseph went looking for them. The city took its name from a Canaanite prince.

shechem-4.title: Shechem
shechem-4.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shechem-4.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

shehariah.title: Shehariah
shehariah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shehariah.note: A Benjamite, son of Jeroham, listed among the heads of families in 1 Chronicles 8:26.

shelah.title: Shelah
shelah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shelah.note: Judah's third son by his Canaanite wife. Judah held him back from marrying Tamar, the widow, as custom said he should. That broken promise is what drove Tamar to disguise herself.

sheleph.title: Sheleph
sheleph.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
sheleph.note: Son of Joktan, and the ancestor of one of the many Joktanite peoples who settled the Arabian peninsula.

shelesh.title: Shelesh
shelesh.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shelesh.note: Son of Helem, of the tribe of Asher, named once in 1 Chronicles 7:35.

shelomith-4.title: Shelomith
shelomith-4.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shelomith-4.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a woman from the divided-kingdom years.

shem.title: Shem
shem.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
shem.note: Noah's oldest son. The Semitic peoples, Abraham's line among them, all trace back to him, and Genesis 10 follows his descendants down to Eber.

shema.title: Shema
shema.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shema.note: Caleb's line through Hebron runs to this Shema, who fathered Raham (1 Chronicles 2:43–44). At least four men carry the name in the lists.

shema-2.title: Shema
shema-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shema-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

shema-3.title: Shema
shema-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shema-3.note: One of 4 men called Shema. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

shemaiah-11.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-11.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
shemaiah-11.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the exile and the return.

shemaiah-6.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-6.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
shemaiah-6.note: A levite from the exile and the return. 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah name him twice.

shemaiah-10.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-10.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shemaiah-10.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

shemaiah-8.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-8.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shemaiah-8.note: One of 26 men called Shemaiah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles. The verse is 1 Chronicles 3:22.

shemaiah-9.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-9.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shemaiah-9.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

shemida.title: Shemida
shemida.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shemida.note: Gilead's son and Manasseh's great-grandson, and his descendants made one of the clans of Manasseh.

shephatiah-2.title: Shephatiah
shephatiah-2.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
shephatiah-2.note: 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the united kingdom.

shephatiah-6.title: Shephatiah
shephatiah-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shephatiah-6.note: A man from the exile and the return, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

shephi.title: Shephi
shephi.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
shephi.note: Son of Shobal, of the line of Seir the Horite, among Edom's clan chiefs, and Genesis 36:23 spells him Shepho.

shephuphan.title: Shephuphan
shephuphan.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shephuphan.note: Bela's son, Benjamin's grandson. The lists also call him Shupham, Shuppim and Muppim, and the Shuphamites came from him.

sherah.title: Sherah
sherah.about: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
sherah.note: She built both towns called Beth-horon, and a third that carries her own name, Uzzen-sherah. She was a daughter of Beriah, in Ephraim's genealogy.

sheshan.title: Sheshan
sheshan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
sheshan.note: He had daughters and no sons, so Chronicles says he married one of them to his Egyptian servant to keep the family line going.

sheva.title: Sheva
sheva.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
sheva.note: There are two. One is a son of Caleb in Judah's genealogy (1 Chronicles 2:49), and the other is one of David's scribes, likely the same official called Seraiah elsewhere.

shilonite.title: Shilonite
shilonite.note: A man from Shiloh. It is what they called the prophet Ahijah, who tore his cloak into twelve pieces to show that God would split Solomon's kingdom.

shilshah.title: Shilshah
shilshah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shilshah.note: A son of Zophah, among Asher's heads of families and fighting men. Nothing else is recorded of him.

shimah.title: Shimah
shimah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimah.note: A Benjamite, son of Jehiel the father of Gibeon, whose family settled in Jerusalem. 1 Chronicles 9:38 calls him Shimeam.

shimea.title: Shimea
shimea.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimea.note: Chronicles uses the name often. It belongs to David's brother at 1 Chronicles 2:13 and 20:7, to one of David's sons at 3:5, and to a Levite at 6:30.

shimea-2.title: Shimea
shimea-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimea-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

shimeah-12.title: Shimeah
shimeah-12.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimeah-12.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once.

shimeah-5.title: Shimeah
shimeah-5.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimeah-5.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him twice.

shimeah-2.title: Shimeah
shimeah-2.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shimeah-2.note: Exodus and 2 other books name him 5 times, and he is a Levite from the wilderness years.

shimeah-10.title: Shimeah
shimeah-10.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimeah-10.note: One of 17 men called Shimeah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

shimeah-11.title: Shimeah
shimeah-11.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimeah-11.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him. The verse is 1 Chronicles 5:4.

shimeah-13.title: Shimeah
shimeah-13.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimeah-13.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

shimeah-4.title: Shimeah
shimeah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimeah-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him. The verses are 1 Chronicles 4:26 and 1 Chronicles 4:27.

shimeam.title: Shimeam
shimeam.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimeam.note: Jehiel founded Gibeon, and Shimeam was one of his descendants among the Benjamite families who resettled Jerusalem. 1 Chronicles 8:32 spells the same man differently.

shimeathites.title: Shimeathites
shimeathites.about: Scribal group in the Old Testament
shimeathites.note: Scribes. They were one of the families living at Jabez, Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

shimon.title: Shimon
shimon.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimon.note: A man of Judah whose four sons are listed in 1 Chronicles 4:20, with no story attached.

shimrath.title: Shimrath
shimrath.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimrath.note: A Benjamite, one of Shimhi's sons, mentioned once and never again.

shimri-3.title: Shimri
shimri-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shimri-3.note: In 1 Chronicles 4:37 he is one link in a short family line, and nothing more is said of him.

shimron.title: Shimron
shimron.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shimron.note: A son of Issachar, and the Shimronites took their name from him.

shiphi.title: Shiphi
shiphi.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shiphi.note: A Simeonite, father of Ziza. In Hezekiah's reign the tribe was pushing out into new pasture near Gedor, and Ziza was one of its leaders.

shobab.title: Shobab
shobab.about: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
shobab.note: One of the sons born to David in Jerusalem after he became king.

shobab-2.title: Shobab
shobab-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shobab-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

shobal.title: Shobal
shobal.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
shobal.note: An Edomite clan chief, descended from Seir. The name was used again for a man of Judah.

shobal-2.title: Shobal
shobal-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shobal-2.note: One of the founders of Kiriath-jearim, from the line of Judah.

shocho-2.title: Shocho
shocho-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shocho-2.note: One of 3 men called Shocho. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

shomer.title: Shomer
shomer.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the years before the monarchy.

shua-2.title: Shua
shua-2.note: Heber's daughter, of the tribe of Asher. She is not the Canaanite whose daughter married Judah.

shuah-2.title: Shuah
shuah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shuah-2.note: Brother of Chelub, in Judah's genealogy (1 Chronicles 4:11). He is not Abraham's son by Keturah.

shuah.title: Shuah
shuah.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
shuah.note: One of the sons Abraham had by Keturah. His people settled in Arabia, and Job's friend Bildad the Shuhite probably came from them.

shual.title: Shual
shual.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shual.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

shumathites.title: Shumathites
shumathites.note: A family of the clans of Kiriath-jearim, named with the Ithrites, Puhites and Mishraites.

shuppim.title: Shuppim
shuppim.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shuppim.note: A Benjamite clan name in 1 Chronicles 7:12 and 7:15.

shuthelah-2.title: Shuthelah
shuthelah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shuthelah-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

shuthelah.title: Shuthelah
shuthelah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
shuthelah.note: Ephraim's son, and his descendants were counted as a clan in the wilderness.

sidon-2.title: Sidon
sidon-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
sidon-2.note: Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the patriarchs.

simeon.title: Simeon
simeon.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
simeon.note: Jacob's second son. With his brother Levi he killed the men of Shechem after their sister Dinah was raped. Jacob held it against them on his deathbed.

sinite.title: Sinite
sinite.note: A Canaanite clan on the Phoenician coast, in the Table of Nations. The city is generally placed near Arka, though no one is certain.

sisamai.title: Sisamai
sisamai.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
sisamai.note: One of Sheshan's descendants through the Jerahmeelite line of Judah. Sheshan had no sons and gave his daughter to an Egyptian servant, and this is the family that came of it.

solomon.title: Solomon
solomon.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
solomon.note: David and Bathsheba's son, and Israel's third king. He was rushed onto the throne after his half-brother Adonijah tried to take it while David lay dying. Early on he asked God for wisdom.

suah.title: Suah
suah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
suah.note: A descendant of Asher, one of Zophah's sons in 1 Chronicles 7:36.

suchathite.title: Suchathite
suchathite.about: Scribal group in the Old Testament
suchathite.note: A family of scribes living at Jabez, named with the Tirathites and Shimeathites. They were Kenites, from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

syrian-3.title: Syrian
syrian-3.about: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
syrian-3.note: One of 3 men called Syrian. This one is a woman from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

taanach.title: Taanach
taanach.note: A Canaanite royal city on the southwest edge of the Jezreel Valley, near Megiddo. Joshua beat its king, the town went to the Levites of Kohath, and its Canaanites were never driven out. Deborah's song puts a battle there by the waters of Megiddo.

taanach-2.title: Taanach
taanach-2.note: Named once, in 1 Chronicles, and nowhere else.

tahan.title: Tahan
tahan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
tahan.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

tahath.title: Tahath
tahath.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
tahath.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

tahath-3.title: Tahath
tahath-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
tahath-3.note: One of 3 men called Tahath. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

tahrea.title: Tahrea
tahrea.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
tahrea.note: Saul's great-grandson through Jonathan and Mephibosheth. The other copy of the list spells him Tarea.

talmai.title: Talmai
talmai.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
talmai.note: A king of Geshur, whose daughter Maacah married David and bore Absalom.

talmon.title: Talmon
talmon.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
talmon.note: He headed a family of temple gatekeepers, and his descendants were still keeping the gates after the exile.

tamar.title: Tamar
tamar.about: David's daughter living at the time of United Monarchy
tamar.note: David's daughter, raped by her half-brother Amnon. David did nothing, and her full brother Absalom had Amnon murdered for it.

tamar-2.title: Tamar
tamar-2.about: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
tamar-2.note: Judah's daughter-in-law, widowed twice with no heir. Judah held back his third son, so she dressed as a prostitute and conceived twins by Judah himself. He ended up saying she was more righteous than he was, and Ruth 4:12 blesses a family in her name.

tappuah-2.title: Tappuah
tappuah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
tappuah-2.note: One of 3 men called Tappuah. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

tarah.title: Tarah
tarah.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
tarah.note: Abraham's father, whose family line Genesis 11 traces. Joshua 24:2 names him again.

tarea.title: Tarea
tarea.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
tarea.note: Saul's line again, through Jonathan, Mephibosheth and Micah. Tarea was Micah's son, and 1 Chronicles 9:41 spells him Tahrea.

tarshish-2.title: Tarshish
tarshish-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
tarshish-2.note: One of 4 men called Tarshish. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

tehinnah.title: Tehinnah
tehinnah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
tehinnah.note: He founded Ir-nahash, the city of Nahash, according to Judah's genealogies.

tekoa.title: Tekoa
tekoa.note: It sat about six miles south of Bethlehem, on the edge of the wilderness that carries its name. Rehoboam fortified it, and Amos was a herdsman there when he was called to prophesy against Israel.

telah.title: Telah
telah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
telah.note: An ancestor of Joshua in Ephraim's genealogy, and that line is all that is recorded of him.

tema-2.title: Tema
tema-2.about: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
tema-2.note: Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the patriarchs.

temani.title: Temani
temani.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
temani.note: Teman was Esau's grandson, and his Edomite clan had a name for wisdom. This is the word for that clan, and it is what Eliphaz is called all through Job.

temeni.title: Temeni
temeni.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
temeni.note: Ashur, the founder of Tekoa, had a son by this name, and the genealogy records nothing else about him.

tiglath-pileser.title: Tiglath-pileser
tiglath-pileser.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
tiglath-pileser.note: He was the third Assyrian king of the name, and he took territory from Israel and Syria and collected tribute. His own inscriptions record the same campaigns and payments 2 Kings describes.

tilon.title: Tilon
tilon.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
tilon.note: One of Shimon's four sons in Judah's genealogy, and nothing more.

timna.title: Timna
timna.about: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
timna.note: Two Edomites. One was a concubine of Esau's son Eliphaz, and her son Amalek fathered the people who were Israel's enemies for generations. The other was an Edomite clan chief.

tiras.title: Tiras
tiras.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
tiras.note: Japheth's youngest son in the Table of Nations. Genesis does not say where his people lived. Josephus connected them with the Thracians, and nobody can confirm it.

tirathite.title: Tirathite
tirathite.about: Scribal group in the Old Testament
tirathite.note: Scribes at Jabez, named with the Shimeathites and Suchathites. They were Kenites from Hammath, father of the house of Rechab.

tirhanah.title: Tirhanah
tirhanah.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
tirhanah.note: Caleb's son by his concubine Maachah, in Judah's genealogy, and that is all.

tiria.title: Tiria
tiria.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
tiria.note: Jehaleleel's son, named in 1 Chronicles 4:16. Nothing else is known.

toah.title: Toah
toah.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
toah.note: A Kohathite Levite in the line that ran down to Samuel and to Heman the singer. Other lists call him Nahath or Tohu.

tochen.title: Tochen
tochen.note: It belonged to Simeon, and nobody knows where it was.

togarmah.title: Togarmah
togarmah.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
togarmah.note: Gomer's son and Japheth's grandson. Ezekiel's people of Togarmah trade horses and mules, from somewhere in eastern Asia Minor.

tola.title: Tola
tola.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
tola.note: Here the verses are the man from the family lists, not the judge. He is in Genesis 46:13 among those who went down to Egypt, and in the Numbers 26 census and 1 Chronicles 7.

tolad.title: Tolad
tolad.note: Simeon's town in the Negev of Judah. Joshua's lists call it Eltolad.

tubal-2.title: Tubal
tubal-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
tubal-2.note: Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the patriarchs.

ulam.title: Ulam
ulam.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ulam.note: Two men of Manasseh's line carry the name in 1 Chronicles 7, and the name turns up in Benjamin too, in a family known for its archers.

ulam-2.title: Ulam
ulam-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ulam-2.note: His name sits in the genealogies of Manasseh and Benjamin. Chronicles notes one family of them for producing a lot of archers.

ulla.title: Ulla
ulla.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ulla.note: Head of a family in Asher, in Jether's line.

uri.title: Uri
uri.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
uri.note: Bezalel's father. Bezalel was the craftsman God picked to build the tabernacle and its furnishings.

uriel-2.title: Uriel
uriel-2.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
uriel-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

uthai.title: Uthai
uthai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uthai.note: The name means helpful. This one was from Judah through Perez, and he settled in Jerusalem after the exile.

uz-3.title: Uz
uz-3.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
uz-3.note: One of 4 men called Uz. This one is a man from the patriarchs, named twice in Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

uz-2.title: Uz
uz-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
uz-2.note: Genesis and 1 Chronicles name him twice, and he is a man from the patriarchs.

uzal.title: Uzal
uzal.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
uzal.note: Joktan's son, and tradition ties the name to an old city in Yemen.

uzza.title: Uzza
uzza.note: Uzzah put his hand out to steady the ark when the oxen stumbled, and he died on the spot. David was afraid, and the ark stayed where it was for three months before it went on to Jerusalem.

uzza-3.title: Uzza
uzza-3.note: One of 3 men called Uzza. This one is a man from the years before the monarchy, named once in 1 Chronicles.

uzzen-sherah.title: Uzzen-sherah
uzzen-sherah.note: The name means ears of Sherah. Sherah, a granddaughter of Ephraim, built this town and both Beth-horons too, which makes her one of the few women in the Old Testament credited with founding towns.

uzzi-2.title: Uzzi
uzzi-2.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
uzzi-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the wilderness years.

uzzi-4.title: Uzzi
uzzi-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uzzi-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

uzzi.title: Uzzi
uzzi.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
uzzi.note: There are several. This one sits in the high priestly line in 1 Chronicles 6, and Ezra 7:4 traces Ezra back through him.

uzzi-3.title: Uzzi
uzzi-3.about: Warrior living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
uzzi-3.note: One of 7 men called Uzzi. This one is a warrior from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

uzziah-3.title: Uzziah
uzziah-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
uzziah-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a Levite from the divided-kingdom years.

uzziel.title: Uzziel
uzziel.about: Aaron's uncle living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
uzziel.note: Kohath's son, and Aaron's uncle. His descendants had their own duties at the tabernacle.

uzziel-3.title: Uzziel
uzziel-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
uzziel-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

uzziel-4.title: Uzziel
uzziel-4.about: Warrior living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
uzziel-4.note: One of 6 men called Uzziel. This one is a warrior from the wilderness years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

zaavan.title: Zaavan
zaavan.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
zaavan.note: An Edomite chief descended from Seir the Horite, also spelled Zavan.

zabad.title: Zabad
zabad.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zabad.note: Several men carry the name. These verses are a man in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles 2, and one in 2 Chronicles 24:26.

zabad-3.title: Zabad
zabad-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zabad-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

zabdi-3.title: Zabdi
zabdi-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zabdi-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

zaccur-3.title: Zaccur
zaccur-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zaccur-3.note: One of 8 men called Zaccur. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

zachariah-8.title: Zachariah
zachariah-8.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zachariah-8.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him once. The verse is 1 Chronicles 5:7.

zachariah-29.title: Zachariah
zachariah-29.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
zachariah-29.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the united kingdom.

zachariah.title: Zachariah
zachariah.about: Singer living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah.note: He was a singer and gatekeeper in Chronicles, one of those who played when the ark came up to Jerusalem.

zadok.title: Zadok
zadok.about: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
zadok.note: The priest who stayed with David through Absalom's rebellion. He would have carried the ark out with the king, and David sent it back. Zadok anointed Solomon, and when Abiathar backed Adonijah and was sent away, Zadok was left as the only high priest.

zadok-2.title: Zadok
zadok-2.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zadok-2.note: A later Zadok in the priestly line, in the genealogies of Chronicles, Ezra and Nehemiah.

zanoah.title: Zanoah
zanoah.note: A town in Judah. Its people repaired one of Jerusalem's gates when Nehemiah rebuilt the walls.

zarah.title: Zarah
zarah.about: Judah's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zarah.note: Judah's son by Tamar, Perez's twin. His hand came out first and the midwife tied a scarlet thread on it, and then Perez was born ahead of him.

zarah-4.title: Zarah
zarah-4.about: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
zarah-4.note: One of 6 men called Zarah. This one is a king from the patriarchs, named twice in Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

zarah-3.title: Zarah
zarah-3.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zarah-3.note: A levite from the divided-kingdom years. 1 Chronicles names him twice.

zarah-5.title: Zarah
zarah-5.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zarah-5.note: A man from the wilderness years, named twice across Numbers and 1 Chronicles.

zarah-2.title: Zarah
zarah-2.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
zarah-2.note: Not Judah's son. This Zerah is in the Genesis 36 family lists and in 1 Chronicles 1:37, one of the Idumaean names.

zaza.title: Zaza
zaza.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zaza.note: One of Jonathan's sons in Jerahmeel's line, in Judah's genealogy, and nothing else.

zebadiah-5.title: Zebadiah
zebadiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zebadiah-5.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

zebadiah-4.title: Zebadiah
zebadiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zebadiah-4.note: One of several men named Zebadiah, this one in the family lists of 1 Chronicles 8.

zebulun.title: Zebulun
zebulun.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
zebulun.note: Jacob's tenth son and Leah's last. His tribe's land ran up to the Sea of Galilee, and Isaiah names it with Naphtali as the place where a light would dawn, which Matthew applies to Jesus in Galilee.

zedekiah.title: Zedekiah
zedekiah.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zedekiah.note: The last king of Judah. Nebuchadnezzar put him on the throne, and he rebelled anyway, against everything Jeremiah told him. Jerusalem was destroyed, he was caught running, his sons were killed in front of him, and then they blinded him.

zedekiah-4.title: Zedekiah
zedekiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zedekiah-4.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

zeker.title: Zeker
zeker.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
zeker.note: A Benjamite in Jeiel's family, part of the line Saul came from. 1 Chronicles 9:37 spells him Zecher.

zelophehad.title: Zelophehad
zelophehad.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zelophehad.note: He died in the wilderness with five daughters and no sons. They went to Moses and asked for their father's land, and they got it, and the law of inheritance changed because of them.

zemarite.title: Zemarite
zemarite.note: A Canaanite people named for Zemar, a Phoenician coastal town under the Lebanon range. The Amarna letters call it Sumur.

zemira.title: Zemira
zemira.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
zemira.note: Becher's son, a Benjamite, in a family known for its fighting men.

zephaniah.title: Zephaniah
zephaniah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zephaniah.note: A priest, not the prophet of the book. Jeremiah's verses show him carrying messages between the king and Jeremiah, and 2 Kings 25:18 counts him among those taken when Jerusalem fell.

zephi.title: Zephi
zephi.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
zephi.note: Eliphaz's son and Esau's grandson, one of the clan chiefs of Edom. Nothing more is recorded.

zerahiah.title: Zerahiah
zerahiah.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zerahiah.note: A priest in the high priestly line, one of the links between Ezra and Aaron.

zereth.title: Zereth
zereth.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zereth.note: Ashhur's son by Helah. Ashhur founded Tekoa, and Zereth has brothers named Zohar and Ethnan, and that is all.

zerubbabel.title: Zerubbabel
zerubbabel.about: Governor living at the time of Exile and Return
zerubbabel.note: He came from David's line and led the first exiles back from Babylon to Jerusalem. As governor he laid the temple's foundation and, with Haggai and Zechariah pushing, saw it finished.

zeruiah.title: Zeruiah
zeruiah.about: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
zeruiah.note: David's sister, the mother of Joab, Abishai and Asahel. David said the sons of Zeruiah were too much for him.

zethan.title: Zethan
zethan.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zethan.note: A Benjamite in the tribe's genealogy at 1 Chronicles 7:10, and nothing more.

zia.title: Zia
zia.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zia.note: He headed a family of Gad, settled in Bashan.

zibeon.title: Zibeon
zibeon.about: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
zibeon.note: A Horite chief in the Edom lists of Genesis 36, and Esau's wife Oholibamah came from his line.

zibia.title: Zibia
zibia.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zibia.note: Shaharaim's descendant, a Benjamite, named once.

zichri-6.title: Zichri
zichri-6.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
zichri-6.note: A levite from the exile and the return. 1 Chronicles names him once.

zichri-3.title: Zichri
zichri-3.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zichri-3.note: 1 Chronicles names him once, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

zichri-4.title: Zichri
zichri-4.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zichri-4.note: One of 12 men called Zichri. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles. The verse is 1 Chronicles 8:23.

zichri-5.title: Zichri
zichri-5.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zichri-5.note: A man from the divided-kingdom years, and 1 Chronicles is the only book that names him.

ziklag.title: Ziklag
ziklag.note: Achish of Gath gave this town in the Negev to David while he was running from Saul, and David lived there more than a year. Amalekites burned it while he was away and took the women and children, and he went after them and got everyone back.

zilthai-2.title: Zilthai
zilthai-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zilthai-2.note: The name means shadow of the LORD. This one headed a Benjamite family in 1 Chronicles 8:20.

zimmah.title: Zimmah
zimmah.about: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zimmah.note: A Levite in Gershon's line, named in the Chronicles genealogies.

zimran.title: Zimran
zimran.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
zimran.note: Abraham's son by Keturah. He is generally taken as the father of an Arabian tribe that nobody can now identify.

zimri.title: Zimri
zimri.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zimri.note: He killed King Elah of Israel and took the throne, and lasted seven days. The army made its own commander king, and Zimri burned the palace down over himself rather than be taken.

zimri-2.title: Zimri
zimri-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zimri-2.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the divided-kingdom years.

ziph.title: Ziph
ziph.note: David hid in the wilderness around Ziph, southeast of Hebron, while Saul was hunting him. The people of Ziph told Saul where he was, twice.

ziph-2.title: Ziph
ziph-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ziph-2.note: One of 3 men called Ziph. This one is a man from the divided-kingdom years, named once in 1 Chronicles.

ziphah.title: Ziphah
ziphah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

ziza.title: Ziza
ziza.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ziza.note: A Simeonite chief whose clan, in Hezekiah's reign, drove out the people of Gedor and took their land.

zobebah.title: Zobebah
zobebah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zobebah.note: Coz's son, in Judah, beside his brother Anub. The verse is one of the loose genealogical scraps in that chapter.

zohar.title: Zohar
zohar.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
zohar.note: Two men. One was Ephron's father, the Hittite who sold Abraham the cave of Machpelah. The other is a son of Simeon in the family lists.

zoheth.title: Zoheth
zoheth.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zoheth.note: Ishi's son, in Judah's genealogy, and that is the whole record.

zophah.title: Zophah
zophah.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zophah.note: Helem's son, a chief of Asher, at the head of a family known for its warriors.

zophai.title: Zophai
zophai.about: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
zophai.note: He was a Kohathite Levite and Samuel's ancestor, also spelled Zuph. The hill country where Elkanah's family lived was called the land of Zuph after him.

zorites.title: Zorites
zorites.note: The people of Zorah, Samson's town on the border of Judah and Dan. Chronicles counts them as a clan among Caleb's descendants.

zur.title: Zur
zur.about: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
zur.note: 1 Chronicles names him twice, and he is a man from the united kingdom.
